section_title_en: 7.1.1 Care and Support for the Mother and Child During Pregnancy
section_title_rw: 7.1.1 Kwita no gufasha umubyeyi n'umwana mu gihe cyo gutwita
label_en: Every pregnant woman has access to antenatal care immediately after missing her periods
label_rw: Umubyeyi wese utwite atangira gukurikiranwa kwa muganga akimara kumenya ko atwite.

section_title_en: 7.1.1 Care and Support for the Mother and Child During Pregnancy
section_title_rw: 7.1.1 Kwita no gufasha umubyeyi n'umwana mu gihe cyo gutwita
label_en: There should be at least eight antenatal contacts during pregnancy
label_rw: Umubyeyi utwite agomba gukurikiranwa kwa muganga nibura inshuro umunani mu gihe cyose atwite.

section_title_en: 7.1.1 Care and Support for the Mother and Child During Pregnancy
section_title_rw: 7.1.1 Kwita no gufasha umubyeyi n'umwana mu gihe cyo gutwita
label_en: Pregnant mothers received regular nutritional assessment, Counselling and provision of Multiple Micronutrient Supplementations (MMS)
label_rw: Ababyeyi batwite basuzumwa imirire yabo buri gihe, bakagirwa inama ku mirire myiza kandi bagahabwa inyunganiramirire zirimo intungamubiri zitandukanye (MMS).

section_title_en: 7.1.1 Care and Support for the Mother and Child During Pregnancy
section_title_rw: 7.1.1 Kwita no gufasha umubyeyi n'umwana mu gihe cyo gutwita
label_en: Fathers provide full support to the pregnant woman: physically, socially, financially, emotionally and psychologically
label_rw: Ababyeyi b’abagabo baha abagore batwite ubufasha bwuzuye, burimo kubafasha mu mirimo, mu mibanire, mu bukungu, mu marangamutima no mu mitekerereze.

section_title_en: 7.1.1 Care and Support for the Mother and Child During Pregnancy
section_title_rw: 7.1.1 Kwita no gufasha umubyeyi n'umwana mu gihe cyo gutwita
label_en: Community health workers (CHW) and Inshuti z'Umuryango (IZUs) conduct home visits to families with pregnant women at least once a month to monitor antenatal care
label_rw: Abajyanama b’Ubuzima (CHW) n’Inshuti z’Umuryango (IZU) basura nibura rimwe mu kwezi ingo zirimo ababyeyi batwite kugira ngo bakurikirane uko bitabwaho mu gihe cyo gutwita.

section_title_en: 7.1.1 Care and Support for the Mother and Child During Pregnancy
section_title_rw: 7.1.1 Kwita no gufasha umubyeyi n'umwana mu gihe cyo gutwita
label_en: Community-based structures (CNF, village committee, Umugoroba w'Imiryango) etc. ensure that the pregnant woman is healthy and secure
label_rw: Inzego z’abaturage (CNF, komite y’umudugudu, Umugoroba w’Imiryango n’izindi) zikurikirana ko umubyeyi utwite afite ubuzima bwiza kandi atekanye.

section_title_en: 7.1.1 Care and Support for the Mother and Child During Pregnancy
section_title_rw: 7.1.1 Kwita no gufasha umubyeyi n'umwana mu gihe cyo gutwita
label_en: Attention is given to marginalized teen and single mothers for adequate antenatal and postnatal care
label_rw: Abangavu batwite n’ababyeyi barera abana bonyine, by’umwihariko abari mu byiciro by’abatishoboye cyangwa bahezwa, bitabwaho kugira ngo babone serivisi zikwiye mbere na nyuma yo kubyara.

section_title_en: 7.1.1 Care and Support for the Mother and Child During Pregnancy
section_title_rw: 7.1.1 Kwita no gufasha umubyeyi n'umwana mu gihe cyo gutwita
label_en: Both parents stimulate the brain and play with babies during pregnancy, for example singing, playing, touching, etc.
label_rw: Ababyeyi bombi bagira uruhare mu gukangura imikurire y’ubwonko bw’umwana ukiri mu nda, urugero nko kumuririmbira, kumuganiriza no gukora ku nda.

section_title_en: 7.1.1 Care and Support for the Mother and Child During Pregnancy
section_title_rw: 7.1.1 Kwita no gufasha umubyeyi n'umwana mu gihe cyo gutwita
label_en: Pregnant women receive adequate nutrition and healthcare including nutrition counselling
label_rw: Ababyeyi batwite babona indyo yuzuye na serivisi z’ubuzima zikwiye, harimo no kugirwa inama ku mirire myiza.

section_title_en: 7.1.1 Care and Support for the Mother and Child During Pregnancy
section_title_rw: 7.1.1 Kwita no gufasha umubyeyi n'umwana mu gihe cyo gutwita
label_en: Pregnant women and fathers of children attend parenting education sessions to learn about the wellbeing of mother and baby
label_rw: Ababyeyi batwite n’abagabo babo bitabira ibiganiro by’uburere kugira ngo bunguke ubumenyi ku mibereho myiza n’ubuzima bw’umubyeyi n’umwana.

section_title_en: 7.1.1 Care and Support for the Mother and Child During Pregnancy
section_title_rw: 7.1.1 Kwita no gufasha umubyeyi n'umwana mu gihe cyo gutwita
label_en: Service providers give a special consideration and first priorities to pregnant women
label_rw: Abatanga serivisi baha ababyeyi batwite umwihariko kandi bakabashyira imbere mu guhabwa serivisi.

section_title_en: 7.1.1 Care and Support for the Mother and Child During Pregnancy
section_title_rw: 7.1.1 Kwita no gufasha umubyeyi n'umwana mu gihe cyo gutwita
label_en: All pregnant women deliver at a health centre/hospital and are accompanied by the father of the child
label_rw: Ababyeyi bose batwite babyarira ku kigo nderabuzima cyangwa ku bitaro kandi bagaherekezwa na se w’umwana.

section_title_en: 7.1.1 Care and Support for the Mother and Child During Pregnancy
section_title_rw: 7.1.1 Kwita no gufasha umubyeyi n'umwana mu gihe cyo gutwita
label_en: The Government at the central and local level supports pregnant women with disabilities to access antenatal services
label_rw: Leta, ku rwego rw’igihugu no mu nzego z’ibanze, ifasha ababyeyi batwite bafite ubumuga kubona serivisi zo kubitaho no kubakurikirana mu gihe batwite.

section_title_en: 7.1.2 Care and Support for Children from Birth to 3 Years
section_title_rw: 7.1.2 Kwita no gufasha abana kuva bakivuka kugeza ku myaka 3
label_en: The mother has access to postnatal care in the first 24 hours after giving birth
label_rw: Umubyeyi abona serivisi zo kwitabwaho no gukurikiranwa mu masaha 24 ya mbere nyuma yo kubyara.

section_title_en: 7.1.2 Care and Support for Children from Birth to 3 Years
section_title_rw: 7.1.2 Kwita no gufasha abana kuva bakivuka kugeza ku myaka 3
label_en: Breastfeeding initiated within the first one hour of birth and the newborn will be on exclusive breastfeeding for six months followed by appropriate complementary feeding and continuation of breastfeeding until two years
label_rw: Umwana atangira konsa mu isaha ya mbere akivuka, akonswa amashereka gusa mu mezi atandatu ya mbere, nyuma agatangira guhabwa imfashabere ikwiye kandi agakomeza konsa kugeza ku myaka ibiri.

section_title_en: 7.1.2 Care and Support for Children from Birth to 3 Years
section_title_rw: 7.1.2 Kwita no gufasha abana kuva bakivuka kugeza ku myaka 3
label_en: Maternity leave regulations ensure that mothers have time to nurture and emotionally bond well with their babies
label_rw: Amabwiriza agenga ikiruhuko cyo kubyara atuma ababyeyi babona igihe gihagije cyo kwita ku bana babo no kubaka umubano mwiza na bo.

section_title_en: 7.1.2 Care and Support for Children from Birth to 3 Years
section_title_rw: 7.1.2 Kwita no gufasha abana kuva bakivuka kugeza ku myaka 3
label_en: Employers grant paternity leave to fathers in accordance with the labour law to also support mothers and bond with the newborn
label_rw: Abakoresha baha abagabo ikiruhuko cyo kubyara giteganywa n’amategeko agenga umurimo, kugira ngo bafashe ababyeyi babyaye kandi bagirane umubano mwiza n’umwana wavutse.

section_title_en: 7.1.2 Care and Support for Children from Birth to 3 Years
section_title_rw: 7.1.2 Kwita no gufasha abana kuva bakivuka kugeza ku myaka 3
label_en: Attention is given to parents in informal sector who do not benefit from paid parental leaves
label_rw: Ababyeyi bakora imirimo itari mu rwego rw’imirimo iteguye bitabwaho by’umwihariko kuko batabona ikiruhuko cyo kubyara gihemberwa.

section_title_en: 7.1.2 Care and Support for Children from Birth to 3 Years
section_title_rw: 7.1.2 Kwita no gufasha abana kuva bakivuka kugeza ku myaka 3
label_en: Support is provided for teen and single mothers who would want to go back to school or gain skills through trainings
label_rw: Abangavu babyaye n’ababyeyi barera abana bonyine bifuza gusubira mu ishuri cyangwa kunguka ubumenyi binyuze mu mahugurwa bahabwa ubufasha bukwiye.

section_title_en: 7.1.2 Care and Support for Children from Birth to 3 Years
section_title_rw: 7.1.2 Kwita no gufasha abana kuva bakivuka kugeza ku myaka 3
label_en: Support and guidance are provided for parents and families with children having developmental delay or disability
label_rw: Ababyeyi n’imiryango ifite abana bafite ubukererwe mu mikurire cyangwa ubumuga bahabwa ubufasha n’ubujyanama bukwiye.

section_title_en: 7.1.2 Care and Support for Children from Birth to 3 Years
section_title_rw: 7.1.2 Kwita no gufasha abana kuva bakivuka kugeza ku myaka 3
label_en: Children should be provided with balanced diet, vitamin A, vaccination, deworming and growth monitoring services at regular basis
label_rw: Abana bahabwa indyo yuzuye, Vitamini A, inkingo n’imiti y’inzoka, kandi imikurire yabo igakurikiranwa buri gihe.

section_title_en: 7.1.2 Care and Support for Children from Birth to 3 Years
section_title_rw: 7.1.2 Kwita no gufasha abana kuva bakivuka kugeza ku myaka 3
label_en: Parents, caregivers and guardians attend parenting education sessions at their nearest ECD facilities to improve the quality of care and support for children
label_rw: Ababyeyi, abarezi n’abashinzwe kwita ku bana bitabira ibiganiro by’uburere ku bigo mbonezamikurire bibegereye kugira ngo barusheho kunoza uburyo bwo kwita no gufasha abana.

section_title_en: 7.1.2 Care and Support for Children from Birth to 3 Years
section_title_rw: 7.1.2 Kwita no gufasha abana kuva bakivuka kugeza ku myaka 3
label_en: CHWs and IZU conduct home visits to families with young children to monitor children's growth and development
label_rw: Abajyanama b’Ubuzima (CHW) n’Inshuti z’Umuryango (IZU) basura ingo zirimo abana bato kugira ngo bakurikirane uko abana bakura n’uko batera imbere mu mikurire yabo.

label_en: The minimum qualification for the staff is secondary certificate (S6) from TTC in Early Childhood Education, ECLPE, and General Education with training on ECD services delivery
label_rw: Urwego rw’amashuri nibura umukozi agomba kuba afite ni impamyabumenyi y’amashuri yisumbuye (S6) yakuye muri TTC mu bijyanye n’uburezi bw’abana bato, ECLPE, cyangwa mu burezi rusange hiyongereyeho amahugurwa ajyanye no gutanga serivisi mbonezamikurire y’abana bato.

label_en: The caregiver has a basic training in holistic child development, childcare methods and first aid
label_rw: Umurezi afite amahugurwa y’ibanze ku mikurire yuzuye y’umwana, uburyo bwo kwita ku mwana n’ubutabazi bw’ibanze.

label_en: Every staff member must submit a medical certificate issued by the competent health institution
label_rw: Buri mukozi agomba gutanga icyemezo cy’uko afite ubuzima buzira umuze gitangwa n’ikigo cy’ubuzima kibifitiye ububasha.

label_en: The caregiver-to-child ratios are observed: 1:3 (3 months to 1 year), 1:5 (1-2 years), 1:10 (2-3 years)
label_rw: Umubare w’abana umurezi umwe agomba kwitaho urubahirizwa: umurezi 1 ku bana 3 bafite kuva ku mezi 3 kugeza ku mwaka 1; umurezi 1 ku bana 5 bafite kuva ku mwaka 1 kugeza ku myaka 2; n’umurezi 1 ku bana 10 bafite kuva ku myaka 2 kugeza ku myaka 3.

label_en: All new staff have induction training in their first week of employment on comprehensive ECD services
label_rw: Abakozi bose bashya bahabwa amahugurwa abamenyereza akazi na serivisi mbonezamikurire y’abana bato mu cyumweru cya mbere batangiye akazi.

label_en: There is a plan for continuous professional development of staff as required
label_rw: Hari gahunda yo gukomeza kongerera abakozi ubumenyi n’ubushobozi mu mwuga hakurikijwe ibisabwa.

label_en: Every staff member in a day-care facility has a working contract
label_rw: Buri mukozi w’ikigo cyita ku bana afite amasezerano y’akazi.

section_title_en: 7.1.4 Sanitary Facilities in a Day-Care Facility
section_title_rw: 7.1.4 Ibikoresho n'ahantu by'isuku mu kigo cyita ku bana
label_en: A clean, washable, hygienic space to change nappies
label_rw: Hari ahantu hasukuye, hashobora kozwa kandi hubahiriza isuku hagenewe guhindurira abana impapuro z’isuku (diapers).

section_title_en: 7.1.4 Sanitary Facilities in a Day-Care Facility
section_title_rw: 7.1.4 Ibikoresho n'ahantu by'isuku mu kigo cyita ku bana
label_en: The nappy changing room is well equipped with hygienic materials such as water and soap and a covered waste bin
label_rw: Ahantu hahindurirwa abana impapuro z’isuku hafite ibikoresho by’isuku bikenewe, birimo amazi, isabune n’indobo y’imyanda ifite umupfundikizo.

section_title_en: 7.1.4 Sanitary Facilities in a Day-Care Facility
section_title_rw: 7.1.4 Ibikoresho n'ahantu by'isuku mu kigo cyita ku bana
label_en: Safe disposal of child faeces
label_rw: Umwanda ukomeye w’abana ujugunywa mu buryo butekanye kandi bubahiriza isuku.

section_title_en: 7.1.4 Sanitary Facilities in a Day-Care Facility
section_title_rw: 7.1.4 Ibikoresho n'ahantu by'isuku mu kigo cyita ku bana
label_en: Age-appropriate toilets for children in the facility, with separate rooms for girls and boys
label_rw: Ikigo gifite ubwiherero bukwiriye imyaka y’abana, kandi abakobwa n’abahungu bafite ubwiherero butandukanye.

section_title_en: 7.1.4 Sanitary Facilities in a Day-Care Facility
section_title_rw: 7.1.4 Ibikoresho n'ahantu by'isuku mu kigo cyita ku bana
label_en: A labelled potty for each child
label_rw: Buri mwana afite agapoto ko kwituma kamugenewe kandi kariho ikimenyetso kimutandukanya n’utundi.

section_title_en: 7.1.4 Sanitary Facilities in a Day-Care Facility
section_title_rw: 7.1.4 Ibikoresho n'ahantu by'isuku mu kigo cyita ku bana
label_en: At least one clean child-sized toilet for 40 children
label_rw: Hari nibura ubwiherero bumwe busukuye kandi bukwiriye abana kuri buri bana 40.

section_title_en: 7.1.4 Sanitary Facilities in a Day-Care Facility
section_title_rw: 7.1.4 Ibikoresho n'ahantu by'isuku mu kigo cyita ku bana
label_en: At least one toilet designed for children with special needs and one for staff with special needs
label_rw: Hari nibura ubwiherero bumwe bwagenewe abana bafite ibikenewe byihariye n’ubundi bumwe bwagenewe abakozi bafite ibikenewe byihariye.

section_title_en: 7.1.4 Sanitary Facilities in a Day-Care Facility
section_title_rw: 7.1.4 Ibikoresho n'ahantu by'isuku mu kigo cyita ku bana
label_en: Potty-chairs are cleaned and sanitized after each use
label_rw: Utugare tw’abana two kwitumamo dusukurwa kandi tugaterwa umuti wica udukoko nyuma ya buri gukoreshwa.

section_title_en: 7.1.4 Sanitary Facilities in a Day-Care Facility
section_title_rw: 7.1.4 Ibikoresho n'ahantu by'isuku mu kigo cyita ku bana
label_en: All sanitary materials are well maintained after use and kept out of reach of children
label_rw: Ibikoresho byose by’isuku bibikwa neza nyuma yo gukoreshwa kandi bigashyirwa aho abana badashobora kubigeraho.

section_title_en: 7.1.4 Sanitary Facilities in a Day-Care Facility
section_title_rw: 7.1.4 Ibikoresho n'ahantu by'isuku mu kigo cyita ku bana
label_en: Sleeping equipment and materials are cleaned, maintained or replaced before they are used for another child
label_rw: Ibikoresho byo kuryamaho bisukurwa, bikabungabungwa cyangwa bigasimbuzwa mbere y’uko bikoreshwa n’undi mwana.

section_title_en: 7.1.4 Sanitary Facilities in a Day-Care Facility
section_title_rw: 7.1.4 Ibikoresho n'ahantu by'isuku mu kigo cyita ku bana
label_en: At least one pair of bed sheets for every child
label_rw: Buri mwana afite nibura amashuka yo kuryamaho amugenewe.

section_title_en: 7.1.4 Sanitary Facilities in a Day-Care Facility
section_title_rw: 7.1.4 Ibikoresho n'ahantu by'isuku mu kigo cyita ku bana
label_en: All waste bins are kept free of insects, rodents and offensive odours
label_rw: Indobo zose z’imyanda zibungabungwa ku buryo zitabamo udukoko n’imbeba kandi ntizigire impumuro mbi.

section_title_en: 7.1.4 Sanitary Facilities in a Day-Care Facility
section_title_rw: 7.1.4 Ibikoresho n'ahantu by'isuku mu kigo cyita ku bana
label_en: Children are guided how to use the waste bins
label_rw: Abana bigishwa uburyo bukwiye bwo gukoresha indobo z’imyanda.

section_title_en: 7.1.4 Sanitary Facilities in a Day-Care Facility
section_title_rw: 7.1.4 Ibikoresho n'ahantu by'isuku mu kigo cyita ku bana
label_en: Table surfaces, furniture and other equipment are cleaned after use
label_rw: Ameza, ibikoresho byo mu byumba n’ibindi bikoresho bisukurwa nyuma yo gukoreshwa.

section_title_en: 7.1.4 Sanitary Facilities in a Day-Care Facility
section_title_rw: 7.1.4 Ibikoresho n'ahantu by'isuku mu kigo cyita ku bana
label_en: Cleaning supplies and toxic materials are kept separate from food and inaccessible to children
label_rw: Ibikoresho by’isuku n’ibintu bishobora guteza uburozi bibikwa kure y’ibiribwa kandi ahantu abana badashobora kubigeraho.

section_title_en: 7.1.4 Sanitary Facilities in a Day-Care Facility
section_title_rw: 7.1.4 Ibikoresho n'ahantu by'isuku mu kigo cyita ku bana
label_en: Each ECD facility has health education posters teaching children hand-washing practices
label_rw: Buri kigo mbonezamikurire gifite ibyapa byigisha abana iby’ubuzima n’uburyo bukwiye bwo gukaraba intoki.

section_title_en: 7.1.4 Sanitary Facilities in a Day-Care Facility
section_title_rw: 7.1.4 Ibikoresho n'ahantu by'isuku mu kigo cyita ku bana
label_en: There is a handwash basin available for handwashing
label_rw: Hari aho gukarabira intoki habugenewe.

section_title_en: 7.1.4 Sanitary Facilities in a Day-Care Facility
section_title_rw: 7.1.4 Ibikoresho n'ahantu by'isuku mu kigo cyita ku bana
label_en: Handwashing station with soap and water is available
label_rw: Hari ahantu ho gukarabira intoki hafite amazi n’isabune.

section_title_en: 7.1.4 Sanitary Facilities in a Day-Care Facility
section_title_rw: 7.1.4 Ibikoresho n'ahantu by'isuku mu kigo cyita ku bana
label_en: Caregivers and children apply the recommended times for handwashing: 40 to 60 seconds
label_rw: Abarezi n’abana bubahiriza igihe cyagenwe cyo gukaraba intoki, kingana n’amasegonda 40 kugeza kuri 60.

label_en: A day-care facility is housed on the ground floor of a building
label_rw: Ikigo cyita ku bana giherereye mu igorofa ryo hasi ry’inyubako.

label_en: A facility not located on the ground floor of the building has grills on the windows and balcony
label_rw: Iyo ikigo kitari mu igorofa ryo hasi, amadirishya na balkoni biba bifite ibyuma bikingira abana.

label_en: The facility is located away from public toilets, rubbish dumps, main roads and other potential health or safety hazards
label_rw: Ikigo giherereye kure y’ubwiherero rusange, ahajugunywa imyanda, imihanda minini n’ahandi hashobora guteza ibyago ku buzima cyangwa ku mutekano w’abana.

label_en: There are no swing doors
label_rw: Nta miryango yifungura cyangwa yikinga ijya impande zombi ihari.

label_en: The floor is smooth, washable, damp-proof and has a non-slip surface
label_rw: Hasi hararinganiye, hashobora gusukurwa, ntihinjiza ubuhehere kandi ntihanyerera.

label_en: Every childcare facility has designated areas for recreational activities
label_rw: Buri kigo cyita ku bana gifite ahantu habugenewe ho gukorera ibikorwa byo kwidagadura no gukina.

label_en: Every childcare facility has specific storage areas
label_rw: Buri kigo cyita ku bana gifite ahantu habugenewe ho kubika ibikoresho.

label_en: Drains are covered
label_rw: Imiyoboro itwara amazi mabi irapfundikiye.

label_en: Where there are staircases, safety gates are installed at both ends of the staircase
label_rw: Aho hari ingazi, hashyirwa amarembo arinda abana ku ntangiriro no ku mpera z’ingazi.

label_en: Electric sockets are raised out of children's reach and are rendered harmless or ineffective to the children
label_rw: Aho amashanyarazi acomekwa hashyirwa hejuru aho abana badashobora kuhagera kandi hagakingirwa ku buryo hatabateza ibyago.

label_en: A childcare facility is accessible to all children including children with disabilities
label_rw: Ikigo cyita ku bana giteye ku buryo abana bose bashobora kukigeramo no kugikoresha, harimo n’abana bafite ubumuga.

label_en: All buildings used as ECD spaces are assessed for safety and must comply with national building safety regulations
label_rw: Inyubako zose zikoreshwa mu bikorwa bya mbonezamikurire y’abana bato zisuzumwa umutekano kandi zikubahiriza amabwiriza y’igihugu agenga umutekano w’inyubako.

label_en: Facilities are equipped with learning materials accessible to all children
label_rw: Ibigo bifite ibikoresho byo kwiga abana bose bashobora kubona no gukoresha.

label_en: The day-care facility has a stimulation room, breastfeeding room, sleeping room, kitchen, store, child-friendly toilets and an outdoor playground
label_rw: Ikigo cyita ku bana gifite icyumba cy’ibikorwa bikangura imikurire y’umwana, icyumba cyo konsa, icyumba cyo kuryamamo, igikoni, ububiko, ubwiherero bubereye abana n’ahantu ho gukinira hanze.

label_en: The premises are clean, well lit, adequately ventilated and maintained in a suitable state of repair; decorations are child friendly
label_rw: Ikigo gifite isuku, urumuri ruhagije n’umwuka uhagije, kandi inyubako n’ibikoresho byacyo bibungabungwa neza; imitako ikoreshwa iba ibereye abana.

label_en: The location is not in a risk zone (landslides, erosion, flooding etc.)
label_rw: Ikigo ntikiri ahantu hashobora kwibasirwa n’ibiza cyangwa ibindi byago, nk’inkangu, isuri n’imyuzure.

label_en: Rooms are maintained at an adequate temperature
label_rw: Ibyumba bigira ubushyuhe bubereye abana.

label_en: There is good lighting
label_rw: Hari urumuri ruhagije.

label_en: Play areas are large enough to allow free movement
label_rw: Ahantu ho gukinira haragutse bihagije ku buryo abana bashobora kuhagendagenda no kuhakinira bisanzuye.

label_en: The sleeping area is spacious, quiet and well ventilated
label_rw: Ahantu ho kuryama haragutse, haratuje kandi hinjiramo umwuka uhagije.

label_en: The compound is regularly cleared and maintained
label_rw: Urugo rw’ikigo rusukurwa kandi rukabungabungwa buri gihe.

label_en: The surface of the outdoor play area is free of sharp objects, harmful plants, rocks and discarded materials and equipment
label_rw: Ahantu abana bakinira hanze nta bintu bikarishye, ibimera bishobora kubangiza, amabuye cyangwa ibikoresho n’imyanda bishobora kubateza ibyago bihari.

label_en: There is at least one toilet for people with disabilities
label_rw: Hari nibura ubwiherero bumwe bwagenewe abantu bafite ubumuga.

label_en: There are handwashing facilities, bassin, soap, clean hand towels or paper towels
label_rw: Hari ahantu habugenewe ho gukarabira intoki, ibase, isabune n’udutambaro dusukuye two guhanagura intoki cyangwa impapuro zabugenewe.

label_en: The nappy changing room is well equipped with hygienic materials such as water and soap and a covered waste bin
label_rw: Ahantu hahindurirwa abana impapuro z’isuku hafite ibikoresho by’isuku bikenewe, birimo amazi, isabune n’indobo y’imyanda ifite umupfundikizo.

label_en: Furniture is appropriate for children's size and age
label_rw: Ibikoresho byo mu byumba bikwiranye n’ingano n’imyaka y’abana.

label_en: Equipment is arranged to create an accessible and stimulating environment
label_rw: Ibikoresho bitondekwa ku buryo abana babigeraho byoroshye kandi bikabafasha gukangura ubushobozi n’imikurire yabo.

label_en: The equipment is of suitable design and condition, well maintained and conforms to safety standards
label_rw: Ibikoresho bikozwe mu buryo bukwiriye, bimeze neza, bibungabungwa neza kandi byubahiriza ibisabwa by’umutekano.

label_en: There are sufficient, suitable indoor and outdoor toys and play materials
label_rw: Hari ibikinisho n’ibikoresho byo gukina bihagije kandi bibereye abana, bikoreshwa haba imbere mu nyubako no hanze.

label_en: Play materials provide stimulating activities and play opportunities for the children in all areas of play, learning and development
label_rw: Ibikoresho byo gukina biha abana amahirwe yo gukora ibikorwa bibakangura kandi bikabafasha mu gukina, kwiga no gutera imbere mu mikurire yabo.

label_en: Play equipment is appropriate to the age and individual developmental needs of the children
label_rw: Ibikoresho byo gukina bikwiranye n’imyaka y’abana ndetse n’ibikenewe na buri mwana mu mikurire ye.

label_en: There are sufficient safe, child age-appropriate chairs, tables, carpets and mats to allow children to play and eat together
label_rw: Hari intebe, ameza, amatapi n’ibyo kwicaraho bihagije, bitekanye kandi bikwiranye n’imyaka y’abana, kugira ngo bashobore gukinira no gusangirira hamwe.

label_en: It is easy to reach and is situated away from the bathroom and from garbage disposal areas
label_rw: Icyumba cyo konsa kiragerwaho byoroshye kandi giherereye kure y’ubwiherero n’ahajugunywa imyanda.

label_en: It complies with privacy standards, with the door securely locked so that lactating mothers can breastfeed undisturbed
label_rw: Icyumba cyubahiriza ubuzima bwite bw’umubyeyi, kandi urugi rushobora gukingwa neza kugira ngo umubyeyi yonsere ahantu hatuje kandi ntawe umuhungabanyije.

label_en: It is only accessed by lactating mothers and cleaners: auditors and administrators may enter, with permission, for a monitoring visit
label_rw: Icyumba kigenewe cyane cyane ababyeyi bonsa n’abakozi bashinzwe isuku; abagenzuzi n’abayobozi bashobora kucyinjiramo babiherewe uburenganzira mu gihe cy’igenzura.

label_en: It is light and airy
label_rw: Icyumba gifite urumuri n’umwuka bihagije.

label_en: The room provides fresh air or a ventilation system for the mother's comfort
label_rw: Icyumba cyinjiramo umwuka mwiza cyangwa gifite uburyo bwo guhererekanya umwuka kugira ngo umubyeyi amererwe neza.

label_en: There are handwashing facilities, soap, clean hand towels or paper towels
label_rw: Hari ahantu ho gukarabira intoki, isabune n’udutambaro dusukuye two guhanagura intoki cyangwa impapuro zabugenewe.

label_en: The room has safe water for drinking and washing hands
label_rw: Icyumba gifite amazi meza kandi atekanye yo kunywa no gukaraba intoki.

label_en: The room has a chair and table adapted for the lactating mother, and other equipment needed by a breastfeeding mother
label_rw: Icyumba gifite intebe n’ameza bibereye umubyeyi wonsa, ndetse n’ibindi bikoresho akenera mu gihe cyo konsa.

label_en: The room has a small baby bed (cot)
label_rw: Icyumba gifite agatanda kabereye umwana muto.

label_en: If the breastfeeding room is used by more than one mother, their seats are separated by a curtain to ensure privacy
label_rw: Iyo icyumba cyo konsa gikoreshwa n’ababyeyi barenze umwe, aho bicara hatandukanywa n’umwenda kugira ngo buri mubyeyi agire ubuzima bwite.

label_en: The breastfeeding room has a sink to clean the cups used by the mother when extracting milk
label_rw: Icyumba cyo konsa gifite aho kogereza ibikoresho umubyeyi akoresha mu gukamisha no kubika amashereka.

label_en: If possible, the room has an electric breast pump for milk extraction, a sterilizing machine and a refrigerator to store the extracted milk
label_rw: Iyo bishoboka, icyumba gifite imashini y’amashanyarazi ikamisha amashereka, igikoresho cyo kwica udukoko ku bikoresho n’firigo yo kubikamo amashereka yakamwe.

label_en: Alternatively, the mother can express breastmilk by hand (she should wash her hands with soap and clean water) and store it in a cupboard
label_rw: Umubyeyi ashobora kandi gukamisha amashereka n’intoki, amaze gukaraba intoki n’amazi meza n’isabune, hanyuma akayabika ahabugenewe.

label_en: Expressed breast milk stored in a safe container at room temperature will last between 6 and 8 hours
label_rw: Amashereka yakamwe agashyirwa mu gikoresho gisukuye kandi gitekanye ashobora kumara amasaha 6 kugeza ku 8 ku bushyuhe busanzwe bwo mu cyumba.

label_en: Every mother has her own storage facility labelled for the left milk/breast milk
label_rw: Buri mubyeyi afite ahantu hamugenewe ho kubika amashereka yakamwe, hariho ikimenyetso cyangwa izina rye kugira ngo atitiranywa n’ay’abandi.

section_title_rw: 7.1.9 Kwita ku bana, kwiga no gukina
label_en: Children have opportunities to explore their world and adequate stimulation by providing items to look at, touch, smell, hear and taste
label_rw: Abana bahabwa amahirwe yo kuvumbura no kumenya ibibakikije binyuze mu bikoresho bashobora kureba, gukoraho, guhumurirwa, kumva no kuryoherwa, bigafasha gukangura imikurire yabo.

section_title_rw: 7.1.9 Kwita ku bana, kwiga no gukina
label_en: Caregivers allow children to engage in creative activities and appreciate their work to boost their self-esteem
label_rw: Abarezi baha abana amahirwe yo gukora ibikorwa bihanga kandi bagashima ibyo bakoze kugira ngo bibafashe kwigirira icyizere.

section_title_rw: 7.1.9 Kwita ku bana, kwiga no gukina
label_en: Children are given appropriate language stimulation activities
label_rw: Abana bahabwa ibikorwa bibafasha guteza imbere ubushobozi bwo kumva no gukoresha ururimi.

section_title_rw: 7.1.9 Kwita ku bana, kwiga no gukina
label_en: Children have support in acquiring new motor, language and thinking skills
label_rw: Abana bafashwa kunguka ubushobozi bushya mu mikorere y’umubiri, mu rurimi no mu mitekerereze.

section_title_rw: 7.1.9 Kwita ku bana, kwiga no gukina
label_en: Children are helped to learning how to control their own behaviour
label_rw: Abana bafashwa kwiga uko bagenzura imyitwarire yabo.

section_title_rw: 7.1.9 Kwita ku bana, kwiga no gukina
label_en: Children are given daily opportunities to play with a variety of objects. Toxic, very tiny or sharp objects are not used
label_rw: Buri munsi abana bahabwa amahirwe yo gukina n’ibikoresho bitandukanye. Ibikoresho birimo uburozi, bito cyane cyangwa bikarishye ntibikoreshwa.

section_title_rw: 7.1.9 Kwita ku bana, kwiga no gukina
label_en: Children may interact with a consistent adult at frequent intervals
label_rw: Abana bahabwa amahirwe yo kugirana imikoranire ihoraho n’umuntu mukuru usanzwe abitaho.

section_title_rw: 7.1.9 Kwita ku bana, kwiga no gukina
label_en: Children are given opportunities to learn to care for themselves: dressing, feeding, washing etc.
label_rw: Abana bahabwa amahirwe yo kwiga kwiyitaho, nko kwiyambika, kwigaburira, kwiyuhagira n’ibindi.

section_title_rw: 7.1.9 Kwita ku bana, kwiga no gukina
label_en: Activities, toys and equipment provide varied sensory experiences
label_rw: Ibikorwa, ibikinisho n’ibikoresho biha abana amahirwe yo gukoresha no guteza imbere ibyumviro byabo bitandukanye.

section_title_rw: 7.1.9 Kwita ku bana, kwiga no gukina
label_en: Staff offer support to children in the activities they choose
label_rw: Abakozi bafasha abana mu bikorwa bahisemo gukora.

section_title_rw: 7.1.9 Kwita ku bana, kwiga no gukina
label_en: Staff listen to children and talk with them about what they are doing
label_rw: Abakozi batega amatwi abana kandi bakaganira na bo ku byo bari gukora.

section_title_rw: 7.1.9 Kwita ku bana, kwiga no gukina
label_en: There are opportunities for children to rest as needed
label_rw: Abana bahabwa amahirwe yo kuruhuka igihe babikeneye.

section_title_rw: 7.1.9 Kwita ku bana, kwiga no gukina
label_en: Children's individual sleeping routines are respected
label_rw: Gahunda n’ibihe byo kuryama bya buri mwana birubahirizwa.

section_title_rw: 7.1.9 Kwita ku bana, kwiga no gukina
label_en: Children are washed before sleeping for a healthy body
label_rw: Abana basukurwa mbere yo kuryama kugira ngo bagire isuku n’ubuzima bwiza.

section_title_rw: 7.1.9 Kwita ku bana, kwiga no gukina
label_en: There are cosmetic materials (lotion and others) for individual child
label_rw: Buri mwana afite ibikoresho bye bwite byo kwisiga no kwita ku mubiri, nk’amavuta yo kwisiga n’ibindi.

section_title_rw: 7.1.9 Kwita ku bana, kwiga no gukina
label_en: There is adequate recreational space for children to relax
label_rw: Hari ahantu hahagije kandi habugenewe abana ho gukinira, kwidagadurira no kuruhukira.

section_title_rw: 7.1.9 Kwita ku bana, kwiga no gukina
label_en: Play items are made of wood or non-toxic materials
label_rw: Ibikoresho byo gukina bikozwe mu biti cyangwa mu bindi bikoresho bitarimo uburozi.

section_title_rw: 7.1.9 Kwita ku bana, kwiga no gukina
label_en: There are swings, climbing frames and other playground equipment
label_rw: Hari ibikoresho byo gukinisha abana birimo imicungo, ibyo kuriraho n’ibindi bikoresho byo ku kibuga cy’imikino.

section_title_rw: 7.1.9 Kwita ku bana, kwiga no gukina
label_en: The number of children does not exceed the capacity of the playground equipment
label_rw: Umubare w’abana bakoresha ibikoresho byo ku kibuga cy’imikino nturenga ubushobozi bwabyo.

section_title_rw: 7.1.9 Kwita ku bana, kwiga no gukina
label_en: Children, up to two years, are screened for developmental delay/disability by CHWs, parents and health professionals every 6 months
label_rw: Abana kugeza ku myaka ibiri basuzumwa buri mezi atandatu kugira ngo harebwe niba nta bukererwe mu mikurire cyangwa ubumuga bafite, bigakorwa n’Abajyanama b’Ubuzima, ababyeyi n’abakozi b’inzego z’ubuzima.

section_title_rw: 7.1.9 Kwita ku bana, kwiga no gukina
label_en: Children identified as being at risk of developmental delay, or who have special needs or disabilities have additional support to meet their individual learning needs
label_rw: Abana bagaragaje ibyago byo kugira ubukererwe mu mikurire, abafite ibikenewe byihariye cyangwa ubumuga bahabwa ubufasha bw’inyongera bujyanye n’ibyo buri mwana akeneye kugira ngo yige kandi atere imbere.

label_en: Parents and caregivers ensure that their children have been immunized according to the vaccination schedule
label_rw: Ababyeyi n’abarezi bakurikirana ko abana bahawe inkingo zose hakurikijwe gahunda y’ikingira.

label_en: ECD caregivers remind parents of the importance of timely immunization
label_rw: Abarezi bo mu bigo mbonezamikurire bibutsa ababyeyi akamaro ko gukingiza abana ku gihe.

label_en: Caregivers check the child's immunization card to ensure that all vaccines have been provided
label_rw: Abarezi bagenzura ikarita y’ikingira y’umwana kugira ngo barebe ko yahawe inkingo zose zisabwa.

label_en: Children are regularly monitored for healthy growth by local CHWs or health professionals
label_rw: Abajyanama b’Ubuzima cyangwa abakozi b’inzego z’ubuzima bakurikirana imikurire y’abana buri gihe kugira ngo barebe ko bakura neza.

label_en: Staff undergo health screening before employment
label_rw: Abakozi basuzumwa ubuzima mbere yo gutangira akazi.

label_en: ECD caregivers ensure that their children receive vitamin A and deworming as per the Ministry of Health calendar and any other preventive and curative measure implemented by the MoH
label_rw: Abarezi bo mu bigo mbonezamikurire bakurikirana ko abana bahabwa Vitamini A n’imiti y’inzoka hakurikijwe gahunda ya Minisiteri y’Ubuzima, ndetse n’izindi serivisi zo gukumira no kuvura indwara ziteganywa na Minisiteri y’Ubuzima.

label_en: Staff are regularly reminded of the importance of good hygiene practices to prevent the spread of infection
label_rw: Abakozi bibutswa buri gihe akamaro ko kubahiriza isuku kugira ngo hirindwe ikwirakwira ry’indwara zandura.

label_en: Those responsible for the preparation and handling of food comply with the established food safety and hygiene regulations
label_rw: Abashinzwe gutegura no gufata ku biribwa bubahiriza amabwiriza yashyizweho ajyanye n’umutekano w’ibiribwa n’isuku.

label_en: Guidelines or protocols on handling sick children with infectious diseases and the use of medicine are available
label_rw: Hari amabwiriza agenga uko hitabwaho abana barwaye indwara zandura n’uko imiti ikoreshwa.

label_en: Medicines are clearly labelled and stored in their original containers
label_rw: Imiti ishyirwaho ibirango bisobanutse kandi ikabikwa mu bikoresho by’umwimerere yazanywemo.

label_en: Medicines are kept out of children's reach
label_rw: Imiti ibikwa ahantu abana badashobora kuyigeraho.

label_en: There are first aid kits and staff are trained how to use them
label_rw: Hari ibikoresho by’ubutabazi bw’ibanze kandi abakozi barahuguwe ku buryo bwo kubikoresha.

label_en: Parents give prior permission for any medication to be administered
label_rw: Ababyeyi babanza gutanga uburenganzira mbere y’uko umwana ahabwa umuti uwo ari wo wose.

label_en: Specific attention is given to children with HIV/AIDS, special needs or disabilities to promote an inclusive, stigma-free environment and support their nutrition and medication
label_rw: Abana babana na VIH/SIDA, abafite ibikenewe byihariye cyangwa ubumuga bitabwaho by’umwihariko, bagahabwa serivisi nta vangura cyangwa akato, kandi bagafashwa kubona imirire n’imiti bikwiye.

label_en: Children are screened for disabilities and special needs to allow appropriate interventions as soon as possible
label_rw: Abana basuzumwa kugira ngo hamenyekane hakiri kare abafite ubumuga cyangwa ibikenewe byihariye, bityo bahabwe ubufasha bukwiye vuba bishoboka.

label_en: Children aged 0-2 years are screened for developmental delay and disability every 6 months
label_rw: Abana bafite kuva ku myaka 0 kugeza kuri 2 basuzumwa buri mezi atandatu kugira ngo harebwe niba bafite ubukererwe mu mikurire cyangwa ubumuga.

label_en: Each child with disabilities and special needs has access to rehabilitation services (such as counselling, physiotherapy, sign language) within the ECD facility and outside
label_rw: Buri mwana ufite ubumuga cyangwa ibikenewe byihariye ahabwa serivisi zo kumufasha gusubirana no guteza imbere ubushobozi bwe, nk’ubujyanama, kuvurwa hakoreshejwe imyitozo ngororamubiri (physiotherapy) n’ururimi rw’amarenga, haba mu kigo mbonezamikurire cyangwa ahandi.

label_en: Day-care owners provide support to services for children with developmental delays and disabilities
label_rw: Abayobozi b’ibigo byita ku bana bashyigikira serivisi zigenewe abana bafite ubukererwe mu mikurire cyangwa ubumuga.

label_en: Day-care facilities ensure children have medical insurance
label_rw: Ibigo byita ku bana bikurikirana ko abana bafite ubwishingizi bwo kwivuza.

label_en: Day-care facilities conduct parent education sessions on family planning
label_rw: Ibigo byita ku bana bitegura ibiganiro bigenewe ababyeyi ku bijyanye no kuboneza urubyaro.

label_en: Health workers' contact details are kept at the facility for health-related issues
label_rw: Ikigo kibika amakuru yo kuvugana n’abakozi b’inzego z’ubuzima kugira ngo bifashishwe igihe hari ikibazo kijyanye n’ubuzima.

label_en: A child or caregiver who contracts or is suspected to have contracted a contagious disease will stay at home until cleared by a healthcare provider
label_rw: Umwana cyangwa umurezi urwaye cyangwa ukekwaho indwara yandura aguma mu rugo kugeza igihe umukozi w’inzego z’ubuzima yemeje ko ashobora gusubira mu kigo.

label_en: The facility is required to close temporarily when there is a threat of, or presence of, an infectious disease outbreak at the facility, as directed by health officials
label_rw: Ikigo gifungwa by’agateganyo igihe hari ibyago byo kwaduka kw’indwara yandura cyangwa iyo yamaze kugaragara mu kigo, hakurikijwe amabwiriza y’inzego z’ubuzima.

label_en: The facility works closely with IZU and local leaders to promote children's safety at household and facility level
label_rw: Ikigo gikorana bya hafi n’Inshuti z’Umuryango (IZU) ndetse n’abayobozi b’inzego z’ibanze mu guteza imbere umutekano w’abana, haba mu ngo no mu kigo.

label_en: Children are provided with healthy, balanced diets as per the National Maternal, Infant and Young Child Feeding Counselling package
label_rw: Abana bahabwa indyo yuzuye kandi iboneye hakurikijwe amabwiriza y’igihugu ajyanye n’imirire y’ababyeyi, impinja n’abana bato.

label_en: Food handlers, including cooks and food suppliers, are trained on food hygiene and safety
label_rw: Abantu bose bategura cyangwa batanga ibiribwa, harimo abateka n’abatanga ibiribwa, bahugurwa ku isuku n’umutekano w’ibiribwa.

label_en: Cooks and food suppliers maintain proper personal hygiene: washing hands, wearing apron/uniform and covering their hair when preparing and serving food
label_rw: Abateka n’abatanga ibiribwa bubahiriza isuku y’umubiri: bakaraba intoki, bakambara agafubiko cyangwa umwambaro wabugenewe kandi bagapfuka umusatsi mu gihe bategura cyangwa batanga ibiribwa.

label_en: Cooks and food suppliers have basic training in hygienic food preparation
label_rw: Abateka n’abatanga ibiribwa bafite amahugurwa y’ibanze ku gutegura ibiribwa mu buryo bubahiriza isuku.

label_en: During meals, children are always supervised by an adult to ensure that all children are eating, to prevent choking and teach good table manners
label_rw: Mu gihe cyo kurya, abana bahora bakurikiranwa n’umuntu mukuru kugira ngo harebwe ko bose barya, hirindwe kunigwa kandi bigishwe imyitwarire myiza mu gihe cyo kurya.

label_en: Caregivers encourage parents/caregivers to practise exclusive breastfeeding during the first 6 months
label_rw: Abarezi bashishikariza ababyeyi n’abita ku bana konsa abana amashereka gusa mu mezi atandatu ya mbere.

label_en: Caregivers encourage parents to provide adequate complementary food in addition to breast milk after 6 months
label_rw: Abarezi bashishikariza ababyeyi guha abana imfashabere ikwiye yiyongera ku mashereka nyuma y’amezi atandatu.

label_en: Clean drinking water is always available to children
label_rw: Abana bahora babona amazi meza kandi atekanye yo kunywa.

label_en: Children spending all day at the day-care facility are offered meals at designated intervals as per age group feeding schedule
label_rw: Abana bamara umunsi wose mu kigo cyita ku bana bahabwa amafunguro ku bihe byagenwe hakurikijwe gahunda y’imirire ijyanye n’imyaka yabo.

label_en: The staff ask parents about any special dietary requirements, preferences or food allergies children may have
label_rw: Abakozi babaza ababyeyi niba abana bafite ibyo bakeneye byihariye mu mirire, ibyo bakunda kurya cyangwa ibiribwa bibatera ubwivumbure bw’umubiri.

label_en: Babies are held upright, close, supported and facing the carer whilst bottle feeding or breastfeeding, preferably by the same carer each time
label_rw: Mu gihe umwana yonswa cyangwa agaburirwa akoresheje icupa, aterurwa neza, agafashwa kwegera umurezi kandi akamureba; iyo bishoboka, akitabwaho n’umurezi umwe buri gihe.

label_en: Facilities for the hygienic preparation of babies' foods are available
label_rw: Hari ahantu n’ibikoresho biboneye byo gutegurira abana bato ibiribwa mu buryo bubahiriza isuku.

label_en: Babies' feeding equipment is sterilized in suitable equipment before every meal
label_rw: Ibikoresho byo kugaburira abana bato byicwaho udukoko mu buryo bukwiye mbere ya buri funguro.

label_en: For children with eating and drinking difficulties, caregivers are trained to adapt feeding practices to minimize harm and maximize nutritional intake
label_rw: Abarezi bahugurwa ku buryo bwo kugaburira abana bafite ingorane zo kurya cyangwa kunywa, kugira ngo hirindwe kubagirira nabi kandi babone intungamubiri zihagije.

label_en: Children with identified feeding difficulties are supported with adequate nutrition to avoid prolonged ill health
label_rw: Abana bagaragaje ingorane mu kurya cyangwa kunywa bahabwa ubufasha bubafasha kubona imirire ihagije no kwirinda ibibazo by’ubuzima bimara igihe kirekire.

label_en: Caregivers ensure that children aged 6-23 months receive micronutrient powders (MNP, ongera intungamubiri) or any other food supplement recommended by the competent authorities
label_rw: Abarezi bakurikirana ko abana bafite amezi 6 kugeza kuri 23 bahabwa ifu y’inyunganiramirire (MNP, Ongera Intungamubiri) cyangwa izindi nyunganiramirire zemewe n’inzego zibifitiye ububasha.

label_en: Parents/caregivers receive monthly cooking demonstrations and sessions on holistic child development at ECD facilities
label_rw: Buri kwezi, ababyeyi n’abita ku bana bahabwa inyigisho ngiro ku gutegura amafunguro ndetse n’ibiganiro ku mikurire yuzuye y’umwana mu bigo mbonezamikurire.

label_en: There is a kitchen garden with fruit and vegetables to contribute to a balanced diet
label_rw: Hari akarima k’igikoni karimo imbuto n’imboga bifasha mu gutegura indyo yuzuye.

label_en: Adequate nutrition and healthcare, including vitamin A supplements, appropriate vaccination, deworming, MNPs and child growth monitoring are regularly provided
label_rw: Abana bahabwa buri gihe imirire na serivisi z’ubuzima bikwiye, harimo Vitamini A, inkingo zisabwa, imiti y’inzoka, inyunganiramirire (MNP) no gukurikirana imikurire yabo.

label_en: Caregivers are trained on safeguarding children's rights and welfare; a safeguarding policy is available and approved by all staff
label_rw: Abarezi bahugurwa ku kurinda uburenganzira n’imibereho myiza by’abana; hari amabwiriza yo kurinda abana azwi kandi yemewe n’abakozi bose.

label_en: All staff are aware of the possible signs of children at risk and are aware of their responsibility to report or act on such issues
label_rw: Abakozi bose bazi ibimenyetso bishobora kugaragaza ko umwana ari mu kaga kandi bazi inshingano zabo zo gutanga amakuru cyangwa kugira icyo bakora igihe babibonye.

label_en: Parents and caregivers protect the child from any form of harm or abuse
label_rw: Ababyeyi n’abarezi barinda umwana uburyo ubwo ari bwo bwose bwo kugirirwa nabi, guhohoterwa cyangwa gukoreshwa nabi.

label_en: The facility is a drug-free environment: people must not smoke, consume alcohol or any prohibited drugs and substances in the child-care facility, during transportation, or on field trips
label_rw: Mu kigo ntibyemewe kunywa cyangwa gukoresha ibiyobyabwenge: nta muntu wemerewe kunywa itabi, inzoga cyangwa gukoresha ibiyobyabwenge n’ibindi bintu bibujijwe mu kigo cyita ku bana, mu gihe cyo gutwara abana cyangwa mu ngendo z’abana.

label_en: To protect children's privacy, taking pictures of children and social media sharing in a childcare facility must not be done without parental consent
label_rw: Mu rwego rwo kurinda ubuzima bwite bw’abana, ntibyemewe gufotora abana cyangwa gusangiza amafoto yabo ku mbuga nkoranyambaga hatabanje kuboneka uburenganzira bw’ababyeyi.

label_en: There are clear mechanisms for dropping off and picking children up from the facility
label_rw: Hari uburyo busobanutse kandi butekanye bwo kuzana abana mu kigo no kubacyura.

label_en: The names and child relationship of the person dropping and picking a child should be well communicated by parents or legal guardians and well recorded by the day-care management
label_rw: Ababyeyi cyangwa abishingizi bemewe n’amategeko bamenyesha ikigo amazina y’umuntu uzana cyangwa ucyura umwana n’isano afitanye na we, kandi ayo makuru akandikwa neza n’ubuyobozi bw’ikigo.

label_en: All activities are supervised by a caregiver
label_rw: Ibikorwa byose by’abana bikurikiranwa n’umurezi.

label_en: The compound is fenced, has a guard and a lockable gate for children's security
label_rw: Urugo rw’ikigo ruzitiye, rufite umuzamu n’irembo rishobora gufungwa neza kugira ngo umutekano w’abana urusheho kubungabungwa.

label_en: Electrical sockets accessible to a child have child-proof covers or safety outlets
label_rw: Aho amashanyarazi acomekwa hashobora kugerwaho n’abana hafite ibipfundikizo cyangwa ubundi buryo bwo gukingira abana impanuka z’amashanyarazi.

label_en: The premises are free from poisonous or potentially harmful plants
label_rw: Mu kigo nta bimera birimo uburozi cyangwa bishobora guteza abana ibyago bihari.

label_en: Ponds, drains, pools or any natural water are fenced, and children are supervised in case they gain access to these facilities
label_rw: Ibyuzi, imiyoboro y’amazi, pisine cyangwa ahandi hari amazi harazitiye, kandi abana bakurikiranwa igihe bashobora kuhagera.

label_en: Operational procedures for the safe conduct of any outings are in place
label_rw: Hari amabwiriza n’uburyo bwashyizweho bwo kurinda umutekano w’abana mu gihe cy’ingendo cyangwa ibikorwa bikorerwa hanze y’ikigo.

label_en: Records are kept of vehicles in which children are transported (including insurance details, service history and a list of named drivers)
label_rw: Habikwa amakuru y’ibinyabiziga bitwara abana, harimo amakuru y’ubwishingizi, uko byagiye bisuzumwa cyangwa bisanwa, n’urutonde rw’abashoferi babitwara.

label_en: Sleeping babies are frequently supervised
label_rw: Abana bato baryamye bakurikiranwa kenshi kugira ngo harebwe ko bameze neza.

label_en: Every facility has fire extinguishers, sand or water and caregivers are trained on how to use them
label_rw: Buri kigo gifite ibyuma bizimya inkongi y’umuriro, umucanga cyangwa amazi, kandi abarezi bahugurwa ku buryo bwo kubikoresha.

label_en: Toys, play materials and equipment are clean and safe for use by children
label_rw: Ibikinisho n’ibindi bikoresho abana bakoresha mu gukina bifite isuku kandi bitekanye.

label_en: All staff should sign a child safeguarding policy and work ethics document before starting work
label_rw: Abakozi bose basinya amabwiriza yo kurinda abana n’inyandiko igenga imyitwarire iboneye mu kazi mbere yo gutangira akazi.

label_en: All toys intended for infants and toddlers are non-toxic, safe and large enough that they cannot be swallowed, are not a choking hazard and cannot be put into children's ears
label_rw: Ibikinisho byose bigenewe impinja n’abana bato ntibirimo uburozi, biratekanye kandi bifite ingano idashobora gutuma umwana abimira, abinigwa na byo cyangwa abishyira mu matwi.

label_en: The kitchen area is not accessible by children unless it is being used solely for a supervised children's activity
label_rw: Abana ntibemerewe kugera mu gikoni keretse igihe kirimo gukoreshwa mu gikorwa cy’abana gikurikiranwa n’umurezi.

label_en: Caregivers for children in the facility are trained on positive behaviour management
label_rw: Abarezi b’abana bo mu kigo bahugurwa ku buryo bwo gutoza no kuyobora imyitwarire myiza.

label_en: Positive behaviour posters are displayed for reference by both children and caregivers
label_rw: Ibyapa bigaragaza imyitwarire myiza bimanikwa aho abana n’abarezi babireba kandi bakabyifashisha.

label_en: Corporal punishment must not be used
label_rw: Gukubita cyangwa guhana abana ku mubiri ntibyemewe.

label_en: Caregivers conduct regular parenting education sessions on positive discipline
label_rw: Abarezi bategura buri gihe ibiganiro by’uburere bw’ababyeyi ku buryo bwo guhana no kuyobora abana mu buryo bwiza.

label_en: There is a system for registering daily attendance by children and staff, showing hours of attendance
label_rw: Hari uburyo bwo kwandika buri munsi ubwitabire bw’abana n’abakozi, harimo n’amasaha bamaze mu kigo.

label_en: An accreditation certificate for the facility must be available
label_rw: Icyemezo cy’uko ikigo cyemewe gukora kigomba kuba gihari.

label_en: Information forms on individual children must be completed, updated and kept confidential
label_rw: Ifishi y’amakuru ya buri mwana yuzuzwa, igahora ivugururwa kandi amakuru akabikwa mu ibanga.

label_en: Health data are well documented and safely kept
label_rw: Amakuru y’ubuzima yandikwa neza kandi akabikwa ahatekanye.

label_en: There is a system for the exchange of information between parents and staff members
label_rw: Hari uburyo bwo guhanahana amakuru hagati y’ababyeyi n’abakozi.

label_en: An occurrence and action logbook/record is kept
label_rw: Habikwa igitabo cyangwa inyandiko y’ibyabaye n’ingamba cyangwa ibikorwa byafashwe.

section_title_rw: 7.1.14 Integanyanyigisho, uburyo bwo kwigisha n'ibikoresho byo gusuzuma
label_en: Learning is holistic and creates opportunities for play-based enquiry and sensory stimulation (exploring environment, manipulating objects, making decisions etc.)
label_rw: Kwiga bikorwa mu buryo bwuzuye kandi biha abana amahirwe yo kwiga binyuze mu gukina, kubaza no gushakashaka no kuvumbura bakoresheje ibyumviro, nko gushakashaka ibibakikije, gukoresha ibintu no gufata ibyemezo.

section_title_rw: 7.1.14 Integanyanyigisho, uburyo bwo kwigisha n'ibikoresho byo gusuzuma
label_en: A daily visual timetable is available
label_rw: Hari gahunda ya buri munsi igaragara mu buryo bw’amashusho.

section_title_rw: 7.1.14 Integanyanyigisho, uburyo bwo kwigisha n'ibikoresho byo gusuzuma
label_en: Caregivers are trained how to use the pre-primary CBC, the national parenting curriculum and early learning and development standards
label_rw: Abarezi bahugurwa ku gukoresha integanyanyigisho ishingiye ku bushobozi (CBC) y’amashuri y’incuke, integanyanyigisho y’igihugu y’uburere bw’ababyeyi n’ibipimo by’imikurire n’imyigire y’abana bato.

section_title_rw: 7.1.14 Integanyanyigisho, uburyo bwo kwigisha n'ibikoresho byo gusuzuma
label_en: Curricula and related guides are available and in use
label_rw: Integanyanyigisho n’amabwiriza ayiherekeza birahari kandi birakoreshwa.

section_title_rw: 7.1.14 Integanyanyigisho, uburyo bwo kwigisha n'ibikoresho byo gusuzuma
label_en: There is a holistic stimulating learning environment
label_rw: Hari ahantu ho kwigira hateza imbere imikurire yuzuye y’umwana kandi hakamukangura.

label_en: A day-care facility may be attended by children from 6 months to 35 months
label_rw: Ikigo cyita ku bana gishobora kwakira abana bafite kuva ku mezi 6 kugeza ku mezi 35.

label_en: Children may quit day-care if they will reach 3 years of age in the first term of the school year
label_rw: Umwana ashobora kuva mu kigo cyita ku bana niba azuzuza imyaka 3 mu gihembwe cya mbere cy’umwaka w’amashuri.

label_en: The birth certificate or immunization card can be referred to when registering the child
label_rw: Mu kwandikisha umwana hashobora kwifashishwa icyemezo cy’amavuko cyangwa ikarita y’ikingira.

label_en: Non-discrimination considerations are observed when admitting children with disabilities and special needs
label_rw: Mu kwakira abana bafite ubumuga cyangwa ibikenewe byihariye hubahirizwa ihame ryo kutavangura.

label_en: There is access to a road
label_rw: Hari umuhanda ugera ku kigo.

label_en: The maximum walking distance from home to the facility does not exceed 1 km
label_rw: Intera ndende umwana agenda n’amaguru ava mu rugo ajya ku kigo ntirenza kilometero 1.

label_en: It is free from excessive noise (workshop, industrial parks and markets)
label_rw: Ikigo giherereye ahantu hatagira urusaku rukabije, nko hafi y’amagaraji, ahakorerwa inganda cyangwa amasoko.

label_en: The location is recognized by local authorities
label_rw: Aho ikigo giherereye hazwi kandi hemewe n’inzego z’ibanze.

label_en: There is a primary school close by to ease the transition from ECD to primary education
label_rw: Hafi y’ikigo hari ishuri ribanza kugira ngo byorohere abana kuva muri ECD bajya mu mashuri abanza.

label_en: There is a health facility nearby
label_rw: Hafi y’ikigo hari ikigo gitanga serivisi z’ubuzima.

label_en: The facility is fenced with durable materials, with a lockable gate that children cannot open
label_rw: Ikigo kizitiwe n’ibikoresho biramba kandi gifite irembo rifungwa abana badashobora kwifungurira.

label_en: The compound and surrounding areas are free from litter and have proper rubbish disposal
label_rw: Urugo rw’ikigo n’ahakikije bifite isuku, nta myanda inyanyagiye kandi hari uburyo bukwiye bwo kujugunya imyanda.

label_en: The compound is safe and secure, free from harmful items such as sharp objects or poisonous plants
label_rw: Urugo rw’ikigo ruratekanye kandi nta bintu bishobora guteza ibyago, nk’ibintu bikarishye cyangwa ibimera birimo uburozi.

label_en: No footpaths cross the facility
label_rw: Nta tuyira tw’abanyamaguru tunyura mu kigo.

label_en: A sign prohibits smoking and alcohol consumption within the premises by staff members and visitors
label_rw: Hari icyapa kibuza abakozi n’abashyitsi kunywa itabi cyangwa inzoga mu kigo.

label_en: The playground is dry, not waterlogged
label_rw: Ikibuga cyo gukiniraho kirumye kandi ntikirimo amazi aretse.

label_en: Potholes and wells are well covered
label_rw: Ibyobo n’amariba bipfundikiye neza.

label_en: The cooking place is far from the play area
label_rw: Ahatekerwa hari kure y’ahantu abana bakinira.

label_en: There is a garden for children to tend and agroforestry trees including fruit trees
label_rw: Hari akarima abana bitaho n’ibiti bivangwa n’imyaka, harimo n’ibiti by’imbuto.

label_en: There is an electricity supply to enable the use of technology
label_rw: Hari amashanyarazi atuma ikigo gishobora gukoresha ikoranabuhanga.

label_en: The service provider consults the district for guidelines on physical accessibility and safety when designing the buildings
label_rw: Utanga serivisi agisha inama akarere ku mabwiriza ajyanye no korohereza abantu kugera ku nyubako no ku mutekano mu gihe cyo kuzishushanya no kuzubaka.

label_en: The service provider complies with the guidelines specified in these standards regarding measurements for buildings and furniture
label_rw: Utanga serivisi yubahiriza amabwiriza agaragara muri ibi bipimo ajyanye n’ingano z’inyubako n’ibikoresho byo mu byumba.

label_en: Equipment and play materials are accessible by all children
label_rw: Ibikoresho n’ibikinisho bishobora kugerwaho no gukoreshwa n’abana bose.

section_title_rw: Indoor Space / 7.2.1.2 Ibyumba by'amashuri / ahantu h'imbere mu nyubako
label_en: At least three classrooms for a complete cycle: Grades 1, 2 and 3
label_rw: Hari nibura ibyumba by’amashuri bitatu byuzuzanya: icyiciro cya 1, icya 2 n’icya 3.

section_title_rw: Indoor Space / 7.2.1.2 Ibyumba by'amashuri / ahantu h'imbere mu nyubako
label_en: To enrol in Grade 1, children are 3 years old or will turn 3 in the first trimester after enrolment
label_rw: Kugira ngo umwana yandikwe mu cyiciro cya 1, aba afite imyaka 3 cyangwa azayuzuza mu mezi atatu ya mbere nyuma yo kwandikwa.

section_title_rw: Indoor Space / 7.2.1.2 Ibyumba by'amashuri / ahantu h'imbere mu nyubako
label_en: The classrooms are child friendly: age appropriate, visually stimulating with meaningful decorations, engaging and culturally appropriate
label_rw: Ibyumba by’amashuri bibereye abana: bikwiranye n’imyaka yabo, bifite ibintu bibakangura mu buryo bwo kureba, imitako ifite icyo ibasobanurira, ibashishikariza kwiga kandi ijyanye n’umuco.

section_title_rw: Indoor Space / 7.2.1.2 Ibyumba by'amashuri / ahantu h'imbere mu nyubako
label_en: There is at least 2 m2 space per child for indoor play and learning
label_rw: Hari nibura metero kare 2 z’umwanya kuri buri mwana wo gukiniramo no kwigiramo imbere mu nyubako.

section_title_rw: Indoor Space / 7.2.1.2 Ibyumba by'amashuri / ahantu h'imbere mu nyubako
label_en: Enrolment for each early learning room does not exceed 30 children
label_rw: Umubare w’abana muri buri cyumba cy’imyigire nturenga 30.

section_title_rw: Indoor Space / 7.2.1.2 Ibyumba by'amashuri / ahantu h'imbere mu nyubako
label_en: The early learning room has a cement/tile/sealed earthen floor and is cleaned every day
label_rw: Icyumba cy’imyigire gifite hasi hasize sima, amabati yo hasi cyangwa ubutaka bwahinduwe neza kandi busukurwa buri munsi.

section_title_rw: Indoor Space / 7.2.1.2 Ibyumba by'amashuri / ahantu h'imbere mu nyubako
label_en: The walls are constructed of durable materials and are painted
label_rw: Inkuta zubakishijwe ibikoresho biramba kandi zirasize irangi.

section_title_rw: Indoor Space / 7.2.1.2 Ibyumba by'amashuri / ahantu h'imbere mu nyubako
label_en: The roof is made of tiles or iron sheets
label_rw: Igisenge gikozwe mu mabati cyangwa mu matafari y’igisenge.

section_title_rw: Indoor Space / 7.2.1.2 Ibyumba by'amashuri / ahantu h'imbere mu nyubako
label_en: Each classroom has two doors
label_rw: Buri cyumba cy’ishuri gifite inzugi ebyiri.

section_title_rw: Indoor Space / 7.2.1.2 Ibyumba by'amashuri / ahantu h'imbere mu nyubako
label_en: Each classroom has two windows of at least 1 m x 1 m to allow sufficient light and ventilation
label_rw: Buri cyumba cy’ishuri gifite amadirishya abiri nibura ya metero 1 kuri metero 1 kugira ngo hinjire urumuri n’umwuka bihagije.

section_title_rw: Indoor Space / 7.2.1.2 Ibyumba by'amashuri / ahantu h'imbere mu nyubako
label_en: Classrooms are accessible for use by children with special needs and have ramps, rails and lower door handles
label_rw: Ibyumba by’amashuri byorohereza abana bafite ibikenewe byihariye kubigeramo no kubikoresha, kandi bifite ramp, ibyuma byo gufata n’imikondo y’inzugi iri hasi.

section_title_rw: Indoor Space / 7.2.1.2 Ibyumba by'amashuri / ahantu h'imbere mu nyubako
label_en: The early learning room is step-free to ease access
label_rw: Mu cyumba cy’imyigire nta ntambwe zibangamira kwinjira.

section_title_rw: Indoor Space / 7.2.1.2 Ibyumba by'amashuri / ahantu h'imbere mu nyubako
label_en: Indoor space allows free movement between furniture for mobility-aid users and children with visual impairment
label_rw: Umwanya w’imbere mu cyumba utuma abakoresha ibikoresho bibafasha kugenda n’abana bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona banyura hagati y’ibikoresho byo mu cyumba bisanzuye kandi batekanye.

section_title_rw: Indoor Space / 7.2.1.2 Ibyumba by'amashuri / ahantu h'imbere mu nyubako
label_en: There is a staff room and an office for the ECD representative/coordinator
label_rw: Hari icyumba cy’abakozi n’ibiro by’uhagarariye cyangwa umuhuzabikorwa wa ECD.

section_title_rw: Indoor Space / 7.2.1.2 Ibyumba by'amashuri / ahantu h'imbere mu nyubako
label_en: There is a store for teaching, learning and other materials
label_rw: Hari ububiko bw’ibikoresho byo kwigisha, kwiga n’ibindi bikoresho.

section_title_rw: Indoor Space / 7.2.1.2 Ibyumba by'amashuri / ahantu h'imbere mu nyubako
label_en: Drawings and other materials displayed on the wall are hung at an appropriate height (20 cm from the floor) so that children can see them easily
label_rw: Ibishushanyo n’ibindi bintu bimanikwa ku nkuta bishyirwa ku burebure bukwiriye, hafi ya santimetero 20 uvuye hasi, kugira ngo abana babibone byoroshye.

label_en: Tables and benches/chairs are child age-appropriate (30 cm high), durable and painted in child-friendly colours
label_rw: Ameza n’intebe cyangwa amabanki bikwiranye n’imyaka y’abana, bifite uburebure hafi ya santimetero 30, biramba kandi bisize amabara abereye abana.

label_en: The ECD classroom and office have a caregiver's chair, table and cupboard
label_rw: Icyumba cya ECD n’ibiro bifite intebe y’umurezi, ameza n’akabati.

label_en: Mats and child-friendly tables are available in each classroom for activities such as reading, storytelling, play, corner play, theme display, group work and other uses
label_rw: Buri cyumba gifite amatapi n’ameza abereye abana akoreshwa mu bikorwa nko gusoma, kuvuga inkuru, gukina, ibikorwa byo mu mfuruka, kugaragaza insanganyamatsiko, imirimo y’amatsinda n’ibindi.

label_en: Open shelves, cupboards, boxes or other containers are used to keep learning materials
label_rw: Hakoreshwa amashelufu afunguye, utubati, udusanduku cyangwa ibindi bikoresho mu kubika ibikoresho byo kwiga.

label_en: Each class has enough bag/clothes hooks for children
label_rw: Buri cyumba gifite ahamanikwa imifuka n’imyenda y’abana hahagije.

label_en: There is a chalkboard or similar large writing surface (movable or fixed)
label_rw: Hari ikibaho cyo kwandikaho cyangwa ubundi buso bunini bwo kwandikaho, bushobora kwimurwa cyangwa kuba buhamye.

label_en: The chalkboard/white board is placed slightly above the floor (20cm) for children to use easily
label_rw: Ikibaho cyirabura cyangwa cy’umweru gishyirwa hafi y’ubutaka, hafi ya santimetero 20 uvuye hasi, kugira ngo abana bagikoreshe byoroshye.

label_en: The kitchen is enclosed (with roof, walls and floor) to protect the cooks, food and utensils from heat, cold, rain and wind
label_rw: Igikoni kirafunze neza kandi gifite igisenge, inkuta na hasi kugira ngo kirinde abateka, ibiribwa n’ibikoresho ubushyuhe, ubukonje, imvura n’umuyaga.

label_en: The cooking place is at least 2 m x 2 m and uses an economical stove or gas cooker
label_rw: Ahatekerwa hafite nibura metero 2 kuri metero 2 kandi hakoreshwa rondereza cyangwa gaz.

label_en: The cooking area is kept clean and tidy
label_rw: Ahatekerwa hahora hasukuye kandi hatunganijwe.

label_en: There is a sink for washing up and a drying area for dishes
label_rw: Hari aho kogereza ibikoresho n’ahantu ho kumishiriza amasahani.

label_en: The kitchen is supplied with clean water
label_rw: Igikoni gifite amazi meza.

label_en: Utensils are safely kept in a well-covered container
label_rw: Ibikoresho byo mu gikoni bibikwa ahatekanye mu gikoresho gifunze neza.

label_en: Plastic items (plates and cups) are not used for hot food or drinks
label_rw: Ibikoresho bya pulasitiki, nk’amasahani n’ibikombe, ntibikoreshwa ku biribwa cyangwa ibinyobwa bishyushye.

label_en: The kitchen is separate from classrooms and toilets
label_rw: Igikoni gitandukanye n’ibyumba by’amashuri n’ubwiherero.

label_en: The kitchen is ventilated, well-lit and has a chimney
label_rw: Igikoni gifite umwuka n’urumuri bihagije kandi gifite umwotsi usohokera hanze.

label_en: The floor is slightly sloping to ease cleaning
label_rw: Hasi mu gikoni haramanuka gato kugira ngo byorohere isuku.

label_en: Waste disposal facilities are in place
label_rw: Hari uburyo n’ibikoresho byo kujugunya imyanda.

label_en: The kitchen has a separate storage room
label_rw: Igikoni gifite icyumba cyihariye cy’ububiko.

label_en: The store is spacious and far from bins and toilets
label_rw: Ububiko buragutse kandi buri kure y’indobo z’imyanda n’ubwiherero.

label_en: There is lockable storage for pre-packed food
label_rw: Hari ahantu hafungwa habikwa ibiribwa bipfunyitse.

label_en: There are lockable cupboards for crockery, cooking utensils, and stores of groceries and other consumables
label_rw: Hari utubati dufungwa tubikwamo amasahani, ibikoresho byo guteka, ibiribwa n’ibindi bikoreshwa.

label_en: The store has pallets
label_rw: Ububiko bufite palete zo gushyiraho ibintu.

label_en: The storeroom is constructed to prevent the entry of rodents and insects
label_rw: Icyumba cy’ububiko cyubatswe ku buryo imbeba n’udukoko bidashobora kukinjiramo.

label_en: Windows and other openings are covered with wire mesh
label_rw: Amadirishya n’ahandi hafunguye bitwikiriwe n’insinga z’akayunguruzo.

label_en: Weighing scales are available
label_rw: Hari iminzani yo gupima ibiro.

label_en: There is at least one latrine per 40 children
label_rw: Hari nibura ubwiherero bumwe kuri buri bana 40.

label_en: There are separate child-friendly and accessible toilets/latrines for boys and for girls, clearly labelled with child-friendly signs
label_rw: Hari ubwiherero butandukanye bw’abahungu n’abakobwa, bubereye abana kandi bworohereza bose kubukoresha, kandi buriho ibimenyetso abana bumva byoroshye.

label_en: Female and male adults have their own separate lockable toilets
label_rw: Abagore n’abagabo bakuru bafite ubwiherero bwabo butandukanye kandi bushobora gufungwa.

label_en: Toilets have adequate light when the door is closed
label_rw: Ubwiherero bufite urumuri ruhagije n’iyo urugi rufunze.

label_en: The toilet facility has a separate storage area to keep cleaning materials away from other cleaning materials
label_rw: Ubwiherero bufite ahantu hihariye ho kubika ibikoresho by’isuku bitandukanye n’ibindi bikoresho.

label_en: All ECD facilities have an on-site toilet/latrine
label_rw: Ibigo byose bya ECD bifite ubwiherero cyangwa umusarani biri mu kigo.

label_en: There is at least one toilet for people with disabilities (step-free, ramp, handrails, wheelchair space, sight-impaired pathway, 100 cm wide door)
label_rw: Hari nibura ubwiherero bumwe bugenewe abantu bafite ubumuga, butagira intambwe zibangamira, bufite ramp, ibyuma byo gufata, umwanya w’intebe y’abafite ubumuga, inzira ifasha abafite ubumuga bwo kutabona n’urugi rwa santimetero 100 z’ubugari.

label_en: Door latches (locks), inside and outside, are fixed no higher than 60-80 cm from the ground for children's easy use
label_rw: Imikondo cyangwa ibifunga by’inzugi, imbere n’inyuma, bishyirwa ku burebure butarenza santimetero 60–80 uvuye hasi kugira ngo abana babikoreshe byoroshye.

label_en: Latches open and close easily without causing injuries
label_rw: Ibifunga by’inzugi birafunguka kandi bigafungwa byoroshye bitabangamira cyangwa ngo bikomeretse abana.

label_en: Toilets doors open outwards with 10 cm free space between the floor and the door
label_rw: Inzugi z’ubwiherero zifungukira hanze kandi hagati y’urugi na hasi hasigara umwanya wa santimetero 10.

label_en: The door height ranges from 100 to 120 cm to let a caregiver open it from the outside if a child is stuck inside
label_rw: Uburebure bw’urugi buri hagati ya santimetero 100 na 120 kugira ngo umurezi ashobore kurufungura ari hanze igihe umwana afungiraniye imbere.

label_en: Latrines are constructed with adequate waste storage so that emptying is easy and is done frequently
label_rw: Imisarani y’ibyobo yubakwa ifite umwanya uhagije wo kubika umwanda ku buryo kuyivoma byoroha kandi bigakorwa kenshi.

label_en: The toilets are equipped with a hygienic, easy-to-clean, slab (solid with no gaps other than the drop hole)
label_rw: Ubwiherero bufite hasi habugenewe, hasukuye kandi horoshye gusukura, hakomeye kandi hatagira imyenge uretse umwobo wo kwituma.

label_en: The diameter of a drop hole in a pit latrine does not exceed 15 cm
label_rw: Umwobo wo kwituma w’umusarani w’icyobo nturenza santimetero 15 z’umurambararo.

label_en: Toilets should be close to classrooms for easy access by young children
label_rw: Ubwiherero buba hafi y’ibyumba by’amashuri kugira ngo abana bato babugereho byoroshye.

label_en: Pit latrines are not less than 6 m deep and are 15 m away from borehole
label_rw: Imisarani y’ibyobo iba ifite ubujyakuzimu butari munsi ya metero 6 kandi iri nibura metero 15 uvuye ku iriba ry’amazi.

label_en: There is a pictorial and printed wash sign on each toilet/latrine door
label_rw: Ku rugi rwa buri bwiherero hari icyapa kirimo ishusho n’amagambo bigaragaza uburyo bwo kubukoresha no kubungabunga isuku.

label_en: There are urinals for boys set at a child-appropriate height (30 cm) from the floor
label_rw: Hari ahantu abahungu banyara hateguwe ku burebure bubereye abana, hafi ya santimetero 30 uvuye hasi.

label_en: The space inside the toilet is large enough to enable caregivers to enter with the child and support the child
label_rw: Imbere mu bwiherero hari umwanya uhagije utuma umurezi ashobora kwinjirana n’umwana no kumufasha.

label_en: Raised footrests are installed on both sides of the hole and should fit children's feet
label_rw: Ku mpande zombi z’umwobo hashyirwa aho abana bashyira ibirenge, hateguwe ku buryo ibirenge byabo bihakwira.

label_en: Handwashing facilities are installed near the toilet for easy access and use
label_rw: Hari ahantu ho gukarabira intoki hafi y’ubwiherero kugira ngo hagerweho kandi hakoreshwe byoroshye.

label_en: The handwashing facility is age appropriate and installed at a height of 50 cm measured from the floor
label_rw: Ahantu ho gukarabira intoki hakwiranye n’imyaka y’abana kandi hashyizwe ku burebure bwa santimetero 50 uvuye hasi.

label_en: The pathways are clean and accessible by children with disabilities
label_rw: Inzira zigana ku bwiherero zifite isuku kandi zishobora gukoreshwa n’abana bafite ubumuga.

label_en: Guiding signs are available to the toilets
label_rw: Hari ibimenyetso biyobora abantu aho ubwiherero buherereye.

label_en: The sleeping space allows boys and girls to sleep separately
label_rw: Ahantu ho kuryama hateguwe ku buryo abahungu n’abakobwa bashobora kuryama batandukanye.

label_en: Sleeping area should provide a minimum of 1.5 m2 per child
label_rw: Ahantu ho kuryama hagomba kugira nibura metero kare 1.5 kuri buri mwana.

label_en: The sleeping space is cemented/tiled/sealed earthen floor and cleaned every day
label_rw: Ahantu ho kuryama hafite hasi hasize sima, amabati yo hasi cyangwa ubutaka bwahinduwe neza kandi hasukurwa buri munsi.

label_en: Furniture and walls are child-friendly (brightly painted with happy images)
label_rw: Ibikoresho byo mu cyumba n’inkuta bibereye abana kandi bisize amabara meza n’amashusho abashimisha.

label_en: Furniture includes a mattress (covered with waterproof material), bed covers, bed sheets and storage space/shelves. Bed covers and bed sheets must be clean
label_rw: Ibikoresho birimo matela itwikiriwe n’ikintu kitinjirwamo n’amazi, ibiringiti cyangwa ibitambaro byo kuryamaho, amashuka n’ahantu ho kubika ibintu cyangwa amashelufu. Ibitambaro n’amashuka bigomba kuba bifite isuku.

label_en: The sleeping room is well lit and ventilated. Windows should have curtains that can be opened and closed
label_rw: Icyumba cyo kuryamamo gifite urumuri n’umwuka bihagije. Amadirishya agira amarido ashobora gukingurwa no gufungwa.

label_en: The outside play area is clean and free from hazards
label_rw: Ahantu ho gukinira hanze harasukuye kandi nta bintu bishobora guteza ibyago.

label_en: There is at least 2 m2 space per child for outdoor play
label_rw: Hari nibura metero kare 2 z’umwanya kuri buri mwana wo gukiniramo hanze.

label_en: Safe outdoor play equipment and materials for motor skills and holistic development is provided: seesaw, slides, swings, merry-go-round, sandbox, set of tyres etc.
label_rw: Hari ibikoresho n’ibikinisho byo hanze bitekanye bifasha imikorere y’umubiri n’imikurire yuzuye, nk’imikino yo kuzamuka no kumanuka, imicungo, ibizunguruka, umusenyi, amapine n’ibindi.

label_en: In the case of a school-based facility the playground is separate from recreational spaces intended for older children
label_rw: Iyo ECD iri ku ishuri, ikibuga cy’abana bato gitandukanye n’ahantu hagenewe imyidagaduro y’abana bakuru.

label_en: The playground has a variety of surfaces: earth, grass or sand
label_rw: Ikibuga gifite ubuso butandukanye, nk’ubutaka, ibyatsi cyangwa umusenyi.

label_en: The playground and materials are adapted for children with special needs
label_rw: Ikibuga n’ibikoresho byo gukina bihuzwa n’ibikenewe n’abana bafite ibikenewe byihariye.

label_en: There is space between items of play equipment so that users of mobility aids can move between them freely and safely
label_rw: Hari umwanya uhagije hagati y’ibikoresho byo gukina kugira ngo abakoresha ibikoresho bibafasha kugenda banyuremo bisanzuye kandi batekanye.

label_en: The space is step-free and well-maintained to ensure children with visual or physical impairments move as independently as possible and without hindrance
label_rw: Ahantu ho gukinira nta ntambwe zibangamira kandi harabungabungwa neza kugira ngo abana bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona cyangwa bw’umubiri bashobore kuhagenda bigenga uko bishoboka kose.

label_en: A fenced playground is available and play equipment is installed to allow a separate running space
label_rw: Hari ikibuga kizitiwe, kandi ibikoresho byo gukina bishyirwa ku buryo hasigara ahantu hihariye ho kwiruka.

label_en: Indoor and outdoor play are always supervised by adult(s)
label_rw: Abana bakurikiranwa buri gihe n’umuntu mukuru igihe bakinira imbere cyangwa hanze.

label_en: There is fixed, child-friendly equipment including low slides and logs to walk on, rubber swing, ladders, tunnels, slides etc.
label_rw: Hari ibikoresho byo gukina bihamye kandi bibereye abana, birimo udutambiko two kunyeraho turi hasi, ibiti byo kugenderaho, imicungo ya reberi, utwuma two kuriraho, tuneli n’ibindi.

label_en: The outdoor play materials are made of plastic or wood - metal equipment should be avoided if possible
label_rw: Ibikoresho byo gukina hanze bikozwe muri pulasitiki cyangwa ibiti; iyo bishoboka, ibikoresho by’icyuma biririndwa.

label_en: There are movable play materials including ropes, balls, tyres, hoops etc.
label_rw: Hari ibikoresho byo gukina byimurwa, birimo imigozi, imipira, amapine, impeta n’ibindi.

label_en: There is a sandpit with recycled scoops and containers
label_rw: Hari ahantu h’umusenyi ho gukinira hafite ibikoresho byo kuyora n’udusanduku byakoreshejwe bundi bushya.

label_en: There is a water play area with recycled containers, hoses and other world discovery tools
label_rw: Hari ahantu ho gukinisha amazi hafite ibikoresho byakoreshejwe bundi bushya, amapayipi n’ibindi bifasha abana kuvumbura ibibakikije.

label_en: Play equipment is accessible by children with disabilities
label_rw: Ibikoresho byo gukina bishobora kugerwaho no gukoreshwa n’abana bafite ubumuga.

label_en: Besides manufactured materials, locally made play and learning materials and toys are available
label_rw: Usibye ibikoresho bikorerwa mu nganda, hari n’ibikoresho byo gukina no kwiga bikorerwa aho ngaho hakoreshejwe ibikoresho biboneka mu gace.

label_en: Children's registration forms including identification, health status, immunizations, contact information and any parent's concerns, are available
label_rw: Ifishi zo kwandikisha abana zirimo amakuru y'irangamuntu, uko ubuzima bwabo buhagaze, inkingo bahawe, amakuru yo kuvugana n'ababyeyi n'ibindi bibazo ababyeyi bagaragaje.

label_en: Immunization cards are verified at the time of registration
label_rw: Ikarita y'ikingira y'umwana igenzurwa igihe yandikishwa.

label_en: The facility has a CHW's contact for health-related issues
label_rw: Ikigo gifite amakuru yo kuvugana n'Umujyanama w'Ubuzima igihe hari ikibazo kijyanye n'ubuzima.

label_en: Children aged 3-5 are screened for developmental delay/disability by CHWs, parents or other health professionals
label_rw: Abana bafite imyaka 3 kugeza kuri 5 basuzumwa kugira ngo harebwe niba bafite ubukererwe mu mikurire cyangwa ubumuga, bigakorwa n'Abajyanama b'Ubuzima, ababyeyi cyangwa abandi bakozi b'inzego z'ubuzima.

label_en: After screening, the ECD facility refers children with suspected developmental disability to specialized services
label_rw: Nyuma yo gusuzumwa, ikigo cya ECD cyohereza abana bakekwaho kugira ubumuga cyangwa ubukererwe mu mikurire muri serivisi zibifitiye ubuhanga.

label_en: Any medicine brought to the facility for children by the family must be prescribed by an authorized healthcare provider
label_rw: Umuti uwo ari wo wose umuryango uzaniye umwana mu kigo ugomba kuba waranditswe n'umukozi w'ubuzima ubifitiye ububasha.

label_en: The name of the child is written on the medicine container as well as the prescribed dosage
label_rw: Izina ry'umwana n'ingano y'umuti agomba guhabwa byandikwa ku gikoresho umuti urimo.

label_en: Containers with safe drinking water and clean cups for each child are available
label_rw: Hari ibikoresho birimo amazi meza yo kunywa n'ibikombe bisukuye bigenewe buri mwana.

label_en: In case of emergency, a caregiver escorts the child to the nearest health post and parents are informed as soon as possible
label_rw: Iyo habaye ikibazo cyihutirwa, umurezi aherekeza umwana ku kigo cy'ubuzima kimwegereye kandi ababyeyi bakamenyeshwa vuba bishoboka.

label_en: Parents/caregivers are encouraged to ensure that their children are immunized on schedule and receive vitamin A and deworming twice a year
label_rw: Ababyeyi n'abarezi bashishikarizwa gukurikirana ko abana bakingirwa ku gihe kandi bagahabwa Vitamini A n'imiti y'inzoka kabiri mu mwaka.

label_en: The facility has information about children with/without medical insurance
label_rw: Ikigo gifite amakuru agaragaza abana bafite ubwishingizi bwo kwivuza n'abatabufite.

label_en: Guidelines with child-friendly pictures are posted on how to manage communicable disease outbreaks and to promote good practices such as handwashing
label_rw: Hamanikwa amabwiriza arimo amashusho abereye abana agaragaza uko indwara zandura zakumirwa n'uko imyitwarire myiza, nko gukaraba intoki, yakurikizwa.

label_en: A child or caregiver who contracts or is suspected to have contracted a contagious disease will stay at home until cleared by a healthcare provider
