label_rw: Umwana cyangwa umurezi urwaye cyangwa ukekwaho indwara yandura aguma mu rugo kugeza igihe umukozi w'ubuzima yemeje ko ashobora gusubira mu kigo.

label_en: Health officials may order the temporary closure of an ECD facility when there is a threat of, or presence of, an infectious disease outbreak at the facility
label_rw: Inzego z'ubuzima zishobora gutegeka ko ikigo cya ECD gifungwa by'agateganyo igihe hari ibyago byo kwaduka kw'indwara yandura cyangwa iyo yamaze kugaragara mu kigo.

label_en: ECD service providers adopt appropriate behaviours regarding prevention and care of children living with HIV/AIDS to promote an inclusive, stigma-free environment
label_rw: Abatanga serivisi za ECD bakurikiza imyitwarire iboneye mu gukumira no kwita ku bana babana na VIH/SIDA, bagaharanira ko nta vangura cyangwa akato.

label_en: The ECD facility works closely with IZU and local leaders to promote safety at household and facility level
label_rw: Ikigo cya ECD gikorana bya hafi n'Inshuti z'Umuryango (IZU) n'abayobozi b'inzego z'ibanze mu guteza imbere umutekano w'abana haba mu ngo no mu kigo.

label_en: Children are provided with healthy, balanced diets as per National Maternal, infant and young child feeding counselling package
label_rw: Abana bahabwa indyo yuzuye kandi iboneye hakurikijwe amabwiriza y'igihugu ajyanye n'imirire y'ababyeyi, impinja n'abana bato.

label_en: Food handlers, including cooks and food suppliers, are trained on food hygiene and safety
label_rw: Abategura cyangwa batanga ibiribwa, harimo abateka n'abatanga ibiribwa, bahugurwa ku isuku n'umutekano w'ibiribwa.

label_en: Cooks and food suppliers maintain proper personal hygiene: washing hands and covering their hair
label_rw: Abateka n'abatanga ibiribwa bubahiriza isuku y'umubiri, harimo gukaraba intoki no gupfuka umusatsi.

label_en: Cooks and food suppliers have basic training in hygienic food preparation
label_rw: Abateka n'abatanga ibiribwa bafite amahugurwa y'ibanze ku gutegura ibiribwa mu buryo bubahiriza isuku.

label_en: During mealtimes, children are always supervised by an adult to ensure that all children are eating, to prevent choking and teach good table manners
label_rw: Mu gihe cyo kurya, abana bahora bakurikiranwa n'umuntu mukuru kugira ngo harebwe ko bose barya, hirindwe kunigwa kandi bigishwe imyitwarire myiza mu gihe cyo kurya.

label_en: The ECD facility has a kitchen garden with fruit and vegetables to be used in as part of a balanced diet
label_rw: Ikigo cya ECD gifite akarima k'igikoni karimo imbuto n'imboga zifashishwa mu gutegura indyo yuzuye.

label_en: Caregivers of children with identified feeding difficulties receive support to provide adequate nutrition
label_rw: Abarezi b'abana bagaragaje ingorane zo kurya cyangwa kunywa bahabwa ubufasha bwo kubaha imirire ihagije.

label_en: Children are accompanied to and from the ECD facility by an adult
label_rw: Abana baherekezwa n'umuntu mukuru igihe bajya ku kigo cya ECD n'igihe bava ku kigo.

label_en: Details of the person dropping and picking a child are communicated and well recorded
label_rw: Amakuru y'umuntu uzana cyangwa ucyura umwana amenyeshwa ikigo kandi akandikwa neza.

label_en: All staff receive regular training on relevant health and safety issues
label_rw: Abakozi bose bahabwa buri gihe amahugurwa ku bibazo by'ubuzima n'umutekano bijyanye n'akazi kabo.

label_en: Staff training includes fire safety precautions and basic first aid for children
label_rw: Amahugurwa y'abakozi arimo kwirinda no guhangana n'inkongi y'umuriro ndetse n'ubutabazi bw'ibanze ku bana.

label_en: Outdoor play equipment is maintained regularly to ensure that it is in good condition and safe for children to use
label_rw: Ibikoresho byo gukina hanze bibungabungwa buri gihe kugira ngo bigume bimeze neza kandi bitekanye ku bana.

label_en: All reasonable precautions are taken to protect children and caregivers from the risk of fire and accidents
label_rw: Hafatwa ingamba zose zikwiye kugira ngo abana n'abarezi barindwe ibyago by'inkongi y'umuriro n'impanuka.

label_en: Where the facility has electricity, covered sockets are used to protect children from electric shock
label_rw: Aho ikigo gifite amashanyarazi, aho acomekwa hapfundikirwa kugira ngo abana barindwe gukubitwa n'amashanyarazi.

label_en: No electric cables are left loose
label_rw: Nta ntsinga z'amashanyarazi zisigara zinyanyagiye cyangwa ziregarega.

label_en: The play area is away from the cooking area
label_rw: Ahantu ho gukinira hari kure y'ahatekerwa.

label_en: The playground is levelled to avoid unnecessary falls
label_rw: Ikibuga cyo gukinira kiraringanizwa kugira ngo hirindwe kugwa bitari ngombwa.

label_en: ECD facilities have a fire extinguisher or a sand bucket and caregivers are trained how to use them
label_rw: Ibigo bya ECD bifite kizimyamoto cyangwa indobo y'umusenyi, kandi abarezi bahugurwa ku buryo bwo kubikoresha.

label_en: First aid kits and any medicines are stored out of children's reach
label_rw: Ibikoresho by'ubutabazi bw'ibanze n'imiti bibikwa aho abana badashobora kubigeraho.

label_en: Contents of the first aid box are checked regularly and replaced when necessary
label_rw: Ibiri mu gasanduku k'ubutabazi bw'ibanze bigenzurwa buri gihe kandi bigasimbuzwa igihe bikenewe.

label_en: All service providers are trained how to use the contents of the first aid box and how to deal with accidents
label_rw: Abatanga serivisi bose bahugurwa ku gukoresha ibiri mu gasanduku k'ubutabazi bw'ibanze no ku buryo bwo kwitwara mu gihe habaye impanuka.

label_en: A lightning conductor is installed on the roof
label_rw: Ku gisenge hashyirwa igikoresho kirinda inyubako inkuba.

label_en: Guidelines to prevent accidents and how to deal with emergencies are posted with child-friendly pictures
label_rw: Hamanikwa amabwiriza arimo amashusho abereye abana agaragaza uko impanuka zakumirwa n'uko ibihe byihutirwa byakwitabwaho.

label_en: Health centre telephone numbers are available to call in case of emergency
label_rw: Nomero za telefone z'ikigo nderabuzima ziboneka ku buryo zihamagazwa igihe habaye ikibazo cyihutirwa.

label_en: Children are supervised by an adult when playing outside
label_rw: Abana bakurikiranwa n'umuntu mukuru igihe bakinira hanze.

label_en: Hazardous/risky play games are discouraged
label_rw: Imikino ishobora guteza ibyago cyangwa impanuka irakumirwa.

label_en: There is a signpost prohibiting intruders inside the ECD facility at the entry point
label_rw: Ku muryango w'ikigo hari icyapa kibuza abantu batabifitiye uburenganzira kwinjira mu kigo cya ECD.

label_en: Measures preventing corporal punishment and abuse are established and communicated to school staff and parents
label_rw: Hari ingamba zo gukumira gukubita abana n'ubundi buryo bwo kubahohotera, kandi izo ngamba zimenyeshwa abakozi n'ababyeyi.

label_en: Hazardous materials and sharp objects are kept out of children's reach. Toys and learning materials are inspected by caregivers before use. Damaged toys are replaced promptly
label_rw: Ibikoresho bishobora guteza ibyago n'ibintu bikarishye bibikwa aho abana badashobora kubigeraho. Abarezi bagenzura ibikinisho n'ibikoresho byo kwiga mbere yo kubikoresha, kandi ibyangiritse bigasimbuzwa vuba.

label_en: All toys intended for younger children are non-toxic, oversized pieces so that children cannot swallow or choke on them, or put them in their ears
label_rw: Ibikinisho byose bigenewe abana bato ntibirimo uburozi kandi bifite ingano ituma umwana adashobora kubimira, kubinigwa na byo cyangwa kubishyira mu matwi.

label_en: The equipment is clean and safe for young children; learning materials and toys are cleaned using a non-harmful cleaning substance and dried regularly
label_rw: Ibikoresho bifite isuku kandi bitekanye ku bana bato; ibikoresho byo kwiga n'ibikinisho bisukurwa hakoreshejwe isabune cyangwa umuti utangiza abana kandi bikumishwa buri gihe.

label_en: All surfaces of play materials are smooth and undamaged, with no sharp edges or protruding surfaces
label_rw: Ubuso bwose bw'ibikoresho byo gukina buroroshye kandi ntibwangiritse, nta mpande zikarishye cyangwa ibice bisongoye.

label_en: Jumping, climbing and sliding areas are covered with soft ground, sand or grass
label_rw: Ahantu ho gusimbukira, kurira no kunyerera hashyirwa ubutaka bworoshye, umusenyi cyangwa ibyatsi.

label_en: ECD facilities create a safe space for children to know their rights and responsibilities
label_rw: Ibigo bya ECD bishyiraho ahantu hatekanye hafasha abana kumenya uburenganzira n'inshingano zabo.

label_en: The compound is fully fenced and has a lockable gate
label_rw: Urugo rw'ikigo rwose ruzitiye kandi rufite irembo rishobora gufungwa.

label_en: A fenced compost pit is located at the farthest corner of the compound
label_rw: Ahantu hakorerwa ifumbire y'imborera harazitiye kandi hashyirwa mu mfuruka y'urugo iri kure cyane.

label_en: Where transport is provided, the vehicle has adequate and comfortable seats fitted with child-appropriate safety belts
label_rw: Iyo ikigo gitanga serivisi yo gutwara abana, ikinyabiziga kiba gifite intebe zihagije kandi zoroheye abana, zifite imikandara y'umutekano ibakwiriye.

label_en: The vehicle to transport children is safe, closed and with windows fixed above child level
label_rw: Ikinyabiziga gitwara abana kiratekanye, kirafunze kandi amadirishya yacyo ari hejuru y'aho abana bashobora kugera.

label_en: Safe drinking water is always available for caregivers and children to drink and for washing hands
label_rw: Amazi meza kandi atekanye ahora ahari kugira ngo abarezi n'abana banywe kandi bakarabe intoki.

label_en: There are adequate water storage containers for drinking water which are cleaned regularly
label_rw: Hari ibikoresho bihagije byo kubikamo amazi yo kunywa kandi bisukurwa buri gihe.

label_en: Children aged 3 are recommended 1,000 ml of water per day while children aged 4-6 years should take 1,200 ml per day
label_rw: Abana bafite imyaka 3 basabwa kunywa mililitiro 1,000 z'amazi ku munsi, naho abafite imyaka 4 kugeza kuri 6 bakanywa mililitiro 1,200 ku munsi.

label_en: Food is cooked using clean water
label_rw: Ibiribwa bitekwa hakoreshejwe amazi meza.

label_en: There is running water at the premises or a public water point no further than 500 m away
label_rw: Mu kigo hari amazi atemba cyangwa hari ivomo rusange riri mu ntera itarenza metero 500.

label_en: There is a staff member in charge of hygiene and sanitation within the premises
label_rw: Hari umukozi ushinzwe isuku n'isukura mu kigo.

label_en: The entire compound and equipment including classrooms, toilets, kitchen and playground are cleaned every day
label_rw: Urugo rwose n'ibikoresho, harimo ibyumba by'amashuri, ubwiherero, igikoni n'ikibuga cyo gukinira, bisukurwa buri munsi.

label_en: Classrooms are clean and have at least one rubbish bin per classroom
label_rw: Ibyumba by'amashuri bifite isuku kandi buri cyumba gifite nibura indobo imwe y'imyanda.

label_en: The facilities are age-appropriate and have user-friendly toilets for children
label_rw: Ibikoresho by'isuku bikwiranye n'imyaka y'abana kandi ubwiherero bworoshye gukoreshwa n'abana.

label_en: Children are clean and wear uniform for easy identification
label_rw: Abana bagira isuku kandi bambara umwambaro w'ikigo kugira ngo bamenyekane byoroshye.

label_en: A water container with clean water and soap is available for use in the classroom, toilets, kitchen, and any other places where washing may be necessary
label_rw: Hari igikoresho kirimo amazi meza n'isabune gikoreshwa mu cyumba cy'ishuri, ku bwiherero, mu gikoni n'ahandi hose gukaraba bikenewe.

label_en: Water containers and clean water for drinking are available
label_rw: Hari ibikoresho byo kubikamo amazi n'amazi meza yo kunywa.

label_en: There are rainwater harvesting facilities
label_rw: Hari uburyo bwo gufata no kubika amazi y'imvura.

label_en: Hygienic materials are available near the toilet: toilet paper, water containers, water and soap for mobile hand washing stations (kandagira ukarabe)
label_rw: Hafi y'ubwiherero hari ibikoresho by'isuku: impapuro z'isuku, ibikoresho by'amazi, amazi n'isabune byo gukoresha kuri kandagira ukarabe.

label_en: Mobile hand washing stations (kandagira ukarabe) and/or a multi-tap handwashing stand are available and inclusive. Caregivers always wash their hands before and after helping children
label_rw: Hari kandagira ukarabe n'aho gukarabira intoki hafite robine nyinshi, kandi ibyo bikoresho bishobora gukoreshwa na bose. Abarezi bakaraba intoki buri gihe mbere na nyuma yo gufasha abana.

label_en: Adequate facilities for the disposal of waste are available, enclosed and regularly collected
label_rw: Hari uburyo buhagije bwo kujugunya imyanda; ahajugunywa imyanda harafunze kandi imyanda igakusanywa buri gihe.

label_en: Bushes and pools of water around the ECD facility are cleared to avoid the possibility of harbouring snakes or breeding mosquitoes
label_rw: Ibihuru n'amazi aretse hafi y'ikigo cya ECD birakurwaho kugira ngo hirindwe inzoka n'ahororokera imibu.

label_en: There are visual health education posters teaching children how to wash their hands properly
label_rw: Hari ibyapa byigisha ubuzima birimo amashusho byerekana abana uburyo bukwiye bwo gukaraba intoki.

label_en: Caregivers ensure that children wash their hands before eating and after using the toilet
label_rw: Abarezi bakurikirana ko abana bakaraba intoki mbere yo kurya na nyuma yo kuva mu bwiherero.

label_en: All WASH facilities are accessible by children with disabilities
label_rw: Ibikoresho byose bya WASH bishobora kugerwaho no gukoreshwa n'abana bafite ubumuga.

label_en: Caregivers apply thematic, integrated, holistic and contextualized approaches: daily and weekly plans are based on themes integrating all learning areas of the competence-based curriculum (CBC)
label_rw: Abarezi bakoresha uburyo bushingiye ku nsanganyamatsiko, buhuza amasomo, bwita ku mikurire yuzuye y'umwana kandi bujyanye n'aho abana bari; gahunda za buri munsi n'iz'icyumweru zishingira ku nsanganyamatsiko zihuza ibyiciro byose by'imyigire biri mu nteganyanyigisho ishingiye ku bushobozi (CBC).

label_en: Caregivers are trained how to use the pre-primary CBC, the national parenting curriculum and early learning and development standards
label_rw: Abarezi bahugurwa ku gukoresha integanyanyigisho ishingiye ku bushobozi (CBC) y'amashuri y'incuke, integanyanyigisho y'igihugu y'uburere bw'ababyeyi n'ibipimo by'imikurire n'imyigire y'abana bato.

label_en: Curricula and related guides are available and in use
label_rw: Integanyanyigisho n'amabwiriza ayiherekeza birahari kandi birakoreshwa.

label_en: Caregivers apply a play-based learning approach: indoor, outdoor, structured, child-centred free play, with gross and fine motor activities rotated in a daily schedule
label_rw: Abarezi bakoresha uburyo bwo kwiga binyuze mu gukina: gukinira imbere no hanze, imikino iteguye n'imikino yisanzuye ishingiye ku mwana, kandi ibikorwa by'imikorere y'ingingo nini n'nto bigasimburana muri gahunda ya buri munsi.

label_en: Caregivers use a multi-sensory approach: activities engage children's senses (sight, hearing, touch, smell and taste)
label_rw: Abarezi bakoresha uburyo bukoresha ibyumviro byinshi: ibikorwa bikoresha kureba, kumva, gukoraho, guhumurirwa no kuryoherwa.

label_en: Caregivers tell/read stories to children reflecting the themes of the week
label_rw: Abarezi babwira cyangwa basomera abana inkuru zijyanye n'insanganyamatsiko y'icyumweru.

label_en: Caregivers use songs/rhymes/poems to develop different skills connected to themes
label_rw: Abarezi bakoresha indirimbo, uturirimbo n'imivugo mu guteza imbere ubushobozi butandukanye bujyanye n'insanganyamatsiko.

label_en: Caregivers use print letters to write for children
label_rw: Abarezi bakoresha inyuguti zanditse mu nyandiko zisomeka neza igihe bandikira abana.

label_en: The ECD facility has plenty of inclusive teaching and learning materials
label_rw: Ikigo cya ECD gifite ibikoresho byinshi byo kwigisha no kwiga bishobora gukoreshwa n'abana bose.

section_title_en: 7.2.1.7 Organizing Teaching, Learning and Play Activities

section_title_en: 7.2.1.7 Organizing Teaching, Learning and Play Activities
section_title_rw: 7.2.1.7 Gutegura ibikorwa byo kwigisha, kwiga no gukina

section_title_en: 7.2.1.7 Organizing Teaching, Learning and Play Activities
section_title_rw: 7.2.1.7 Gutegura ibikorwa byo kwigisha, kwiga no gukina

section_title_en: 7.2.1.7 Organizing Teaching, Learning and Play Activities
section_title_rw: 7.2.1.7 Gutegura ibikorwa byo kwigisha, kwiga no gukina

section_title_en: 7.2.1.7 Organizing Teaching, Learning and Play Activities
section_title_rw: 7.2.1.7 Gutegura ibikorwa byo kwigisha, kwiga no gukina

section_title_en: 7.2.1.7 Organizing Teaching, Learning and Play Activities
section_title_rw: 7.2.1.7 Gutegura ibikorwa byo kwigisha, kwiga no gukina

section_title_en: 7.2.1.7 Organizing Teaching, Learning and Play Activities
section_title_rw: 7.2.1.7 Gutegura ibikorwa byo kwigisha, kwiga no gukina

section_title_en: 7.2.1.7 Organizing Teaching, Learning and Play Activities
section_title_rw: 7.2.1.7 Gutegura ibikorwa byo kwigisha, kwiga no gukina

section_title_en: 7.2.1.7 Organizing Teaching, Learning and Play Activities
section_title_rw: 7.2.1.7 Gutegura ibikorwa byo kwigisha, kwiga no gukina

section_title_en: 7.2.1.7 Organizing Teaching, Learning and Play Activities
section_title_rw: 7.2.1.7 Gutegura ibikorwa byo kwigisha, kwiga no gukina
label_en: The classroom encourages children to play and there are various materials, including those locally available, to stimulate children's analytical thinking and exploration

section_title_en: 7.2.1.7 Organizing Teaching, Learning and Play Activities
section_title_rw: 7.2.1.7 Gutegura ibikorwa byo kwigisha, kwiga no gukina
label_en: Caregivers are creative and keep the displays in print-rich classrooms updated
label_rw: Abarezi barahanga kandi bahora bavugurura ibimanitswe mu byumba bikungahaye ku nyandiko.

section_title_en: 7.2.1.7 Organizing Teaching, Learning and Play Activities
section_title_rw: 7.2.1.7 Gutegura ibikorwa byo kwigisha, kwiga no gukina
label_en: Children's original drawings, writing and other work are displayed on the walls at their eye level
label_rw: Ibishushanyo, inyandiko n'indi mirimo y'umwimerere y'abana bimanikwa ku nkuta ku burebure bw'amaso yabo.

section_title_en: 7.2.1.7 Organizing Teaching, Learning and Play Activities
section_title_rw: 7.2.1.7 Gutegura ibikorwa byo kwigisha, kwiga no gukina
label_en: Children with communication needs receive support to use different communication method(s): sign language, gesture, pictures, objects and tactile communication systems, or a combination of these
label_rw: Abana bafite ibibazo byo kuvugana bahabwa ubufasha bwo gukoresha uburyo butandukanye, nk'ururimi rw'amarenga, ibimenyetso by'umubiri, amashusho, ibintu bifatika n'uburyo bwo kuvugana hakoreshejwe gukoraho, cyangwa kubihuza.

section_title_en: 7.2.1.7 Organizing Teaching, Learning and Play Activities
section_title_rw: 7.2.1.7 Gutegura ibikorwa byo kwigisha, kwiga no gukina
label_en: An adult/caregiver supervises the sharing of outdoor play equipment
label_rw: Umuntu mukuru cyangwa umurezi akurikirana uburyo abana basangira ibikoresho byo gukina hanze.

section_title_en: 7.2.1.7 Organizing Teaching, Learning and Play Activities
section_title_rw: 7.2.1.7 Gutegura ibikorwa byo kwigisha, kwiga no gukina
label_en: Children identified as being at risk of/experiencing developmental delay or disability receive additional support to meet their individual learning needs
label_rw: Abana bagaragayeho ibyago cyangwa ibimenyetso by'ubukererwe mu mikurire cyangwa ubumuga bahabwa ubufasha bw'inyongera bujyanye n'ibyo buri mwana akeneye mu kwiga.

section_title_en: 7.2.1.7 Organizing Teaching, Learning and Play Activities
section_title_rw: 7.2.1.7 Gutegura ibikorwa byo kwigisha, kwiga no gukina
label_en: Each child with disability and special needs has an individual education plan
label_rw: Buri mwana ufite ubumuga cyangwa ibikenewe byihariye agira gahunda y'uburezi yihariye.

section_title_en: 7.2.1.7 Organizing Teaching, Learning and Play Activities
section_title_rw: 7.2.1.7 Gutegura ibikorwa byo kwigisha, kwiga no gukina
label_en: Routines, teaching and learning strategies, the learning environment, equipment and play/learning materials are inclusive to accommodate children with disabilities and special needs by applying universal design for learning (UDL) principles
label_rw: Gahunda za buri munsi, uburyo bwo kwigisha no kwiga, aho kwigira, ibikoresho n'ibikinisho cyangwa ibikoresho byo kwiga bitegurwa ku buryo bidaheza abana bafite ubumuga n'ibikenewe byihariye, hakurikijwe amahame ya Universal Design for Learning (UDL).

section_title_en: 7.2.1.7 Organizing Teaching, Learning and Play Activities
section_title_rw: 7.2.1.7 Gutegura ibikorwa byo kwigisha, kwiga no gukina
label_en: Assessment tools and materials are adapted to cater for children with special needs and disabilities
label_rw: Ibikoresho n'uburyo bwo gusuzuma bihindurwa kugira ngo bikwiranye n'abana bafite ibikenewe byihariye cyangwa ubumuga.

section_title_en: 7.2.1.7 Organizing Teaching, Learning and Play Activities
section_title_rw: 7.2.1.7 Gutegura ibikorwa byo kwigisha, kwiga no gukina
label_en: For children diagnosed with the most severe/profound learning needs by competent professionals, special educational provision is advised
label_rw: Ku bana basuzumwe n'abahanga babifitiye ububasha bagasanga bafite ibikenewe bikomeye cyane mu myigire, hatangwa inama yo kubashakira uburezi bwihariye bubakwiriye.

section_title_rw: 7.2.1.7 Ibikoresho byo kwigisha, kwiga no gukina
label_en: Play materials are adapted to be suitable for all children
label_rw: Ibikoresho byo gukina bihindurwa cyangwa bigatoranywa ku buryo bikwiranye n'abana bose.

section_title_rw: 7.2.1.7 Ibikoresho byo kwigisha, kwiga no gukina
label_en: Appropriate learning materials for all learning areas are available: numeracy, language and literacy, creative art and culture, discovery of the world, social and emotional development, physical development and health
label_rw: Hari ibikoresho bikwiye byo kwiga mu byiciro byose by'imyigire: imibare, ururimi no gusoma no kwandika, ubuhanzi n'umuco, kuvumbura isi, imikurire y'imibanire n'amarangamutima, imikurire y'umubiri n'ubuzima.

section_title_rw: 7.2.1.7 Ibikoresho byo kwigisha, kwiga no gukina
label_en: Learning and play materials are accessible to all children in all six learning areas of the curriculum. These materials are kept in open shelves and other containers
label_rw: Ibikoresho byo kwiga no gukina bishobora kugerwaho n'abana bose mu byiciro bitandatu by'imyigire. Bibikwa ku mashelufu afunguye no mu bindi bikoresho.

section_title_rw: 7.2.1.7 Ibikoresho byo kwigisha, kwiga no gukina
label_en: Learning promotes the use of Information and Communication Technology (ICT) in activities such as lesson preparation, making materials, research etc.
label_rw: Kwiga biteza imbere ikoreshwa ry'Ikoranabuhanga mu Itumanaho n'Itangazamakuru (ICT) mu bikorwa nko gutegura amasomo, gukora ibikoresho no gukora ubushakashatsi.

section_title_rw: 7.2.1.7 Ibikoresho byo kwigisha, kwiga no gukina
label_en: The facility has a variety of Rwandan picture books with culturally and age-appropriate stories
label_rw: Ikigo gifite ibitabo bitandukanye by'amashusho byo mu Rwanda birimo inkuru zijyanye n'umuco kandi zibereye imyaka y'abana.

section_title_rw: 7.2.1.7 Ibikoresho byo kwigisha, kwiga no gukina
label_en: Children's pre-writing materials (pencils, chalk, crayons, paper and drawing notebooks) are available
label_rw: Hari ibikoresho by'abana bibanziriza kwandika, nk'amakaramu, ingwa, amakaramu y'amabara, impapuro n'amakayi yo gushushanyamo.

section_title_rw: 7.2.1.7 Ibikoresho byo kwigisha, kwiga no gukina
label_en: Materials are mostly locally available; culturally acceptable; age appropriate; inclusive; durable; safe and clean; attractive; multipurpose; gender sensitive and stimulating children's minds and senses; in good condition
label_rw: Ibikoresho byinshi biboneka mu gace, byemewe mu muco, bikwiranye n'imyaka, bidaheza, biramba, bitekanye kandi bifite isuku, birashimishije, bifite imikoreshereze myinshi, byita ku buringanire bw'abahungu n'abakobwa kandi bikangura ubwenge n'ibyumviro by'abana; kandi bimeze neza.

section_title_rw: 7.2.1.7 Ibikoresho byo kwigisha, kwiga no gukina
label_en: Play materials are appropriate to the community context and imitate the games children play at home
label_rw: Ibikoresho byo gukina bijyanye n'imibereho y'abaturage kandi bigana imikino abana bakina iwabo.

section_title_rw: 7.2.1.7 Ibikoresho byo kwigisha, kwiga no gukina
label_en: Learning materials used are maintained and stored correctly to ensure their safety after use
label_rw: Ibikoresho byo kwiga byakoreshejwe bibungabungwa kandi bikabikwa neza kugira ngo bigume bitekanye nyuma yo gukoreshwa.

section_title_rw: 7.2.1.7 Ibikoresho byo kwigisha, kwiga no gukina
label_en: The facility has one copy of the national pre-primary curriculum for each caregiver
label_rw: Ikigo gifite kopi imwe y'integanyanyigisho y'igihugu y'amashuri y'incuke kuri buri murezi.

section_title_rw: 7.2.1.7 Ibikoresho byo kwigisha, kwiga no gukina
label_en: The facility has and uses CBC guides, schemes of work, training modules, the national parenting curriculum, early learning and development standards and other relevant documents
label_rw: Ikigo gifite kandi gikoresha amabwiriza ya CBC, gahunda z'imirimo, inyandiko z'amahugurwa, integanyanyigisho y'igihugu y'uburere bw'ababyeyi, ibipimo by'imikurire n'imyigire y'abana bato n'izindi nyandiko zibishamikiyeho.

section_title_rw: 7.2.1.7 Ibikoresho byo kwigisha, kwiga no gukina
label_en: Play materials can be bought or improvised from locally available materials
label_rw: Ibikoresho byo gukina bishobora kugurwa cyangwa bigakorwa hifashishijwe ibikoresho biboneka mu gace.

section_title_rw: 7.2.1.7 Ibikoresho byo kwigisha, kwiga no gukina
label_en: Manila paper sacks and other locally available materials for display are available
label_rw: Hari impapuro za Manila, imifuka y'impapuro n'ibindi bikoresho biboneka mu gace bikoreshwa mu kumanika no kwerekana ibikorwa.

section_title_rw: 7.2.1.7 Ingendo zo kwiga no gusura ahantu hatandukanye
label_en: Children leave the ECD facility compound to explore themes within their community every week
label_rw: Buri cyumweru abana basohoka mu rugo rw'ikigo cya ECD kugira ngo bajye gusobanukirwa insanganyamatsiko binyuze mu gusura no kuvumbura ibiri mu gace batuyemo.

section_title_rw: 7.2.1.7 Ingendo zo kwiga no gusura ahantu hatandukanye
label_en: One caregiver or parent supervises a group of up to 10 children and has a list of those children with parents' contacts
label_rw: Umurezi cyangwa umubyeyi umwe akurikirana itsinda ritarenze abana 10 kandi afite urutonde rw'abo bana n'amakuru yo kuvugana n'ababyeyi babo.

section_title_rw: 7.2.1.7 Ingendo zo kwiga no gusura ahantu hatandukanye
label_en: Parents sign a consent form for visits
label_rw: Ababyeyi basinya urupapuro rutanga uburenganzira bwo kujyana abana mu ngendo zo kwiga.

section_title_rw: 7.2.1.7 Ingendo zo kwiga no gusura ahantu hatandukanye
label_en: The lead caregiver carries the first aid kit during the study visit
label_rw: Umurezi uyoboye urugendo yitwaza ibikoresho by'ubutabazi bw'ibanze mu gihe cy'urugendo rwo kwiga.

section_title_rw: 7.2.1.7 Ingendo zo kwiga no gusura ahantu hatandukanye
label_en: The facility carries out a risk assessment and adopts related coping mechanisms to ensure the security and safety of the trip beforehand
label_rw: Mbere y'urugendo, ikigo gisuzuma ibyago bishobora kubaho kandi kigashyiraho ingamba zo kubikumira no kubyitwaramo kugira ngo urugendo rugire umutekano.

label_en: To set up an ECD facility, the service provider follows defined application procedures
label_rw: Mu gushinga ikigo cya ECD, utanga serivisi akurikiza inzira n'amabwiriza yashyizweho yo gusaba uburenganzira.

label_en: Model ECD and School Based ECD must register their services to competent authority
label_rw: Model ECD na School-Based ECD bigomba kwandikisha serivisi zabyo ku rwego rubifitiye ububasha.

label_en: The competent authority reviews applications, inspects prospective ECD facility. If satisfactory, it can provide an accreditation
label_rw: Urwego rubifitiye ububasha rusuzuma ubusabe kandi rugenzura ikigo cya ECD giteganywa. Iyo cyujuje ibisabwa, rushobora kugiha icyemezo cy'ubuziranenge cyangwa uburenganzira bwo gukora.

section_title_en: 7.2.1.9 Effective Partnership and Networking with Families and Communities
label_en: The service provider involves parents/guardians in setting up ECD services and programmes
label_rw: Utanga serivisi agira ababyeyi cyangwa abishingizi uruhare mu gushyiraho serivisi na gahunda za ECD.

section_title_en: 7.2.1.9 Effective Partnership and Networking with Families and Communities
label_en: All parents/guardians meet in a general assembly at least once a month
label_rw: Ababyeyi cyangwa abishingizi bose baterana mu nteko rusange nibura rimwe mu kwezi.

section_title_en: 7.2.1.9 Effective Partnership and Networking with Families and Communities
label_en: Parents/guardians/caregivers are advisors/counsellors in supporting children's holistic development and well-being
label_rw: Ababyeyi, abishingizi n'abarezi bagira uruhare nk'abajyanama mu gushyigikira imikurire yuzuye n'imibereho myiza y'abana.

section_title_en: 7.2.1.9 Effective Partnership and Networking with Families and Communities
label_en: An ECD facility has a parent committee composed of: Two parent representatives (male and female), ECD coordinator, Caregiver, Village leader
label_rw: Ikigo cya ECD gifite komite y'ababyeyi igizwe n'abahagarariye ababyeyi babiri, umugabo n'umugore, umuhuzabikorwa wa ECD, umurezi n'umuyobozi w'umudugudu.

section_title_en: 7.2.1.9 Effective Partnership and Networking with Families and Communities
label_en: The service provider allows children at risk of developmental delay or disability to be enrolled
label_rw: Utanga serivisi yemera kwandikisha abana bafite ibyago byo kugira ubukererwe mu mikurire cyangwa ubumuga.

section_title_en: 7.2.1.9 Effective Partnership and Networking with Families and Communities
label_en: There are communication and feedback mechanisms between parents and the facility management (notebook, journal, WhatsApp group, phone calls, SMS etc.)
label_rw: Hari uburyo bwo gutumanaho no gutanga ibitekerezo hagati y'ababyeyi n'ubuyobozi bw'ikigo, nko gukoresha agaderno, ikayi y'itumanaho, itsinda rya WhatsApp, telefone cyangwa SMS.

section_title_en: 7.2.1.9 Effective Partnership and Networking with Families and Communities
label_en: The facility collaborates with the local authorities; collaboration is evidenced by monthly reports, meetings and supervision
label_rw: Ikigo gikorana n'inzego z'ibanze, kandi ubwo bufatanye bugaragazwa na raporo za buri kwezi, inama n'igenzura.

section_title_en: 7.2.1.9 Effective Partnership and Networking with Families and Communities
label_en: The facility organizes and keeps records of monthly parenting sessions
label_rw: Ikigo gitegura ibiganiro by'uburere bw'ababyeyi buri kwezi kandi kikabika inyandiko zabyo.

section_title_rw: 7.2.1.10 Gusuzuma imikurire y'abana n'intambwe bagezeho mu myigire
label_en: Mid-term progress reports of each child are available

section_title_rw: 7.2.1.10 Gusuzuma imikurire y'abana n'intambwe bagezeho mu myigire
label_en: Children's portfolios are available
label_rw: Hari dosiye cyangwa ikusanyirizo ry'imirimo ya buri mwana.

section_title_en: 7.2.1.10 Assessment of Children's Development and Learning Progress
section_title_rw: 7.2.1.10 Gusuzuma imikurire y'abana n'intambwe bagezeho mu myigire
label_en: Progress reports are shared and discussed with individual parents and/or groups of parents
label_rw: Raporo z'iterambere zisangizwa kandi zikaganirwaho n'umubyeyi ku giti cye cyangwa n'amatsinda y'ababyeyi.

section_title_en: 7.2.1.10 Assessment of Children's Development and Learning Progress
section_title_rw: 7.2.1.10 Gusuzuma imikurire y'abana n'intambwe bagezeho mu myigire
label_en: ECD caregivers analyse children's progress and adjust their processes, tools and practices accordingly
label_rw: Abarezi ba ECD basesengura intambwe abana batera maze bagahindura uburyo, ibikoresho n'imikorere yabo hakurikijwe ibyo basanze.

section_title_en: 7.2.1.10 Assessment of Children's Development and Learning Progress
section_title_rw: 7.2.1.10 Gusuzuma imikurire y'abana n'intambwe bagezeho mu myigire
label_en: ECD caregivers meet every week in communities of practice (COPs) to reflect on the effectiveness of their processes, tools and practices
label_rw: Abarezi ba ECD bahura buri cyumweru mu matsinda y'imyigire y'umwuga (COP) kugira ngo basuzume uko uburyo, ibikoresho n'imikorere yabo bitanga umusaruro.

section_title_en: 7.2.1.10 Assessment of Children's Development and Learning Progress
section_title_rw: 7.2.1.10 Gusuzuma imikurire y'abana n'intambwe bagezeho mu myigire
label_en: Children's progress reports contain detailed developmental and learning information
label_rw: Raporo z'iterambere ry'abana zirimo amakuru arambuye ku mikurire no ku myigire yabo.

section_title_en: 7.2.1.10 Assessment of Children's Development and Learning Progress
section_title_rw: 7.2.1.10 Gusuzuma imikurire y'abana n'intambwe bagezeho mu myigire
label_en: Colour-coded rating is used to share children's progress with parents: GREEN, BLUE, YELLOW, RED
label_rw: Hakoreshwa amabara mu kugaragariza ababyeyi intambwe abana bagezeho: ICYATSI, UBUKOBWA, UMUHONDO n'UMUTUKU.

section_title_en: 7.2.1.10 Assessment of Children's Development and Learning Progress
section_title_rw: 7.2.1.10 Gusuzuma imikurire y'abana n'intambwe bagezeho mu myigire
label_en: Assessment results in ECD facilities recorded in MINEDUC's comprehensive assessment management information system (CAMIS)
label_rw: Ibisubizo by'isuzuma mu bigo bya ECD byandikwa muri sisitemu ya MINEDUC yo gucunga amakuru y'isuzuma (CAMIS).

section_title_en: 7.2.1.11 Qualifications, Training and Incentives for Caregivers and Cooks
section_title_rw: 7.2.1.11 Ubumenyi, amahugurwa n'uburyo bwo gushishikariza abarezi n'abateka
label_en: The recruitment of caregivers follows national procedures governing teacher recruitment in Rwanda or caregiver management guidelines
label_rw: Gushaka no guhitamo abarezi bikorwa hakurikijwe amabwiriza y'igihugu agenga itangwa ry'akazi ku barimu mu Rwanda cyangwa amabwiriza agenga imicungire y'abarezi.

section_title_en: 7.2.1.11 Qualifications, Training and Incentives for Caregivers and Cooks
section_title_rw: 7.2.1.11 Ubumenyi, amahugurwa n'uburyo bwo gushishikariza abarezi n'abateka
label_en: Each room in an ECD facility has a caregiver and an assistant
label_rw: Buri cyumba mu kigo cya ECD gifite umurezi n'umufasha we.

section_title_en: 7.2.1.11 Qualifications, Training and Incentives for Caregivers and Cooks
section_title_rw: 7.2.1.11 Ubumenyi, amahugurwa n'uburyo bwo gushishikariza abarezi n'abateka
label_en: Each facility has at least one cook and one guard
label_rw: Buri kigo gifite nibura umutetsi umwe n'umuzamu umwe.

section_title_en: 7.2.1.11 Qualifications, Training and Incentives for Caregivers and Cooks
section_title_rw: 7.2.1.11 Ubumenyi, amahugurwa n'uburyo bwo gushishikariza abarezi n'abateka
label_en: ECD caregiver is at least 18 years old
label_rw: Umurezi wa ECD aba afite nibura imyaka 18.

section_title_en: 7.2.1.11 Qualifications, Training and Incentives for Caregivers and Cooks
section_title_rw: 7.2.1.11 Ubumenyi, amahugurwa n'uburyo bwo gushishikariza abarezi n'abateka
label_en: The minimum qualification for the staff is secondary certificate (S6) from TTC in Early Childhood Education, ECLPE, and General Education with training on ECD services delivery
label_rw: Urwego rw'amashuri nibura umukozi agomba kuba afite ni impamyabumenyi y'amashuri yisumbuye (S6) yakuye muri TTC mu bijyanye n'uburezi bw'abana bato, ECLPE, cyangwa mu burezi rusange hiyongereyeho amahugurwa ajyanye no gutanga serivisi za ECD.

section_title_en: 7.2.1.11 Qualifications, Training and Incentives for Caregivers and Cooks
section_title_rw: 7.2.1.11 Ubumenyi, amahugurwa n'uburyo bwo gushishikariza abarezi n'abateka
label_en: Caregivers demonstrate positive values and respect for children in their respective communities
label_rw: Abarezi bagaragaza indangagaciro nziza kandi bakubaha abana mu baturage babamo.

section_title_en: 7.2.1.11 Qualifications, Training and Incentives for Caregivers and Cooks
section_title_rw: 7.2.1.11 Ubumenyi, amahugurwa n'uburyo bwo gushishikariza abarezi n'abateka
label_en: Caregivers dress decently, are good role models to young children and respect the role of parents in bringing up children
label_rw: Abarezi bambara neza kandi mu buryo buboneye, bakabera abana bato urugero rwiza kandi bakubaha uruhare rw'ababyeyi mu kurera abana.

section_title_en: 7.2.1.11 Qualifications, Training and Incentives for Caregivers and Cooks
section_title_rw: 7.2.1.11 Ubumenyi, amahugurwa n'uburyo bwo gushishikariza abarezi n'abateka
label_en: Caregivers are able to make toys from locally available materials
label_rw: Abarezi bashobora gukora ibikinisho bifashishije ibikoresho biboneka mu gace.

section_title_en: 7.2.1.11 Qualifications, Training and Incentives for Caregivers and Cooks
section_title_rw: 7.2.1.11 Ubumenyi, amahugurwa n'uburyo bwo gushishikariza abarezi n'abateka
label_en: Caregivers never use any form of corporal punishment or psychological abuse
label_rw: Abarezi ntibakoresha na rimwe igihano cyo ku mubiri cyangwa ihohoterwa ryo mu mitekerereze.

section_title_en: 7.2.1.11 Qualifications, Training and Incentives for Caregivers and Cooks
section_title_rw: 7.2.1.11 Ubumenyi, amahugurwa n'uburyo bwo gushishikariza abarezi n'abateka
label_en: Caregivers have the basic knowledge and skills to identify and handle children with disabilities and special needs
label_rw: Abarezi bafite ubumenyi n'ubushobozi bw'ibanze bwo kumenya no gufasha abana bafite ubumuga cyangwa ibikenewe byihariye.

section_title_en: 7.2.1.11 Qualifications, Training and Incentives for Caregivers and Cooks
section_title_rw: 7.2.1.11 Ubumenyi, amahugurwa n'uburyo bwo gushishikariza abarezi n'abateka
label_en: Caregiver-child ratio is observed: Grade 1: 1:15, Grade 2: 1:25, Grade 3: 1:30
label_rw: Umubare w'abana ku murezi urubahirizwa: icyiciro cya 1, umurezi 1 ku bana 15; icyiciro cya 2, umurezi 1 ku bana 25; icyiciro cya 3, umurezi 1 ku bana 30.

section_title_en: 7.2.1.11 Qualifications, Training and Incentives for Caregivers and Cooks
section_title_rw: 7.2.1.11 Ubumenyi, amahugurwa n'uburyo bwo gushishikariza abarezi n'abateka
label_en: Caregivers and support staff are continuously trained and mentored as needed
label_rw: Abarezi n'abakozi bafasha bahabwa amahugurwa n'ubujyanama bw'umwuga bikomeza, hakurikijwe ibikenewe.

section_title_en: 7.2.1.11 Qualifications, Training and Incentives for Caregivers and Cooks
section_title_rw: 7.2.1.11 Ubumenyi, amahugurwa n'uburyo bwo gushishikariza abarezi n'abateka
label_en: CPD is organized by the facility's administration or by linking with other institutions
label_rw: Amahugurwa yo gukomeza guteza imbere umwuga (CPD) ategurwa n'ubuyobozi bw'ikigo cyangwa ku bufatanye n'ibindi bigo.

section_title_en: 7.2.1.11 Qualifications, Training and Incentives for Caregivers and Cooks
section_title_rw: 7.2.1.11 Ubumenyi, amahugurwa n'uburyo bwo gushishikariza abarezi n'abateka
label_en: Internal CPD is conducted at least once a week through COP/mentors
label_rw: Amahugurwa ya CPD ategurwa imbere mu kigo nibura rimwe mu cyumweru binyuze mu matsinda ya COP cyangwa abajyanama b'umwuga.

section_title_en: 7.2.1.11 Qualifications, Training and Incentives for Caregivers and Cooks
section_title_rw: 7.2.1.11 Ubumenyi, amahugurwa n'uburyo bwo gushishikariza abarezi n'abateka
label_en: All ECD providers receive initial and ongoing training on inclusive ECD care and learning for children at risk of/with developmental delay or disability
label_rw: Abatanga serivisi bose za ECD bahabwa amahugurwa y'ibanze n'akomeza ku buryo bwo kwita no kwigisha mu buryo budaheza abana bafite ibyago byo kugira, cyangwa bafite, ubukererwe mu mikurire cyangwa ubumuga.

section_title_en: 7.2.1.11 Qualifications, Training and Incentives for Caregivers and Cooks
section_title_rw: 7.2.1.11 Ubumenyi, amahugurwa n'uburyo bwo gushishikariza abarezi n'abateka
label_en: The validation of training content in the ECD programme is done jointly by the Rwanda Basic Education Board (REB) and NCDA
label_rw: Ibikubiye mu mahugurwa ya gahunda ya ECD byemezwa ku bufatanye na Rwanda Basic Education Board (REB) na NCDA.

section_title_en: 7.2.1.11 Qualifications, Training and Incentives for Caregivers and Cooks
section_title_rw: 7.2.1.11 Ubumenyi, amahugurwa n'uburyo bwo gushishikariza abarezi n'abateka
label_en: Caregivers and support staff are entitled to salary or fringe benefits/incentives
label_rw: Abarezi n'abakozi bafasha bagenerwa umushahara cyangwa izindi nyungu n'udushimwe bibashishikariza.

section_title_en: 7.2.1.11 Qualifications, Training and Incentives for Caregivers and Cooks
section_title_rw: 7.2.1.11 Ubumenyi, amahugurwa n'uburyo bwo gushishikariza abarezi n'abateka
label_en: Caregivers are capacitated and provided with teaching/learning materials and empowered to creatively develop them
label_rw: Abarezi bongererwa ubushobozi, bagahabwa ibikoresho byo kwigisha no kwiga kandi bagashishikarizwa kubihanga no kubyikorera.
